Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

We are looking for a Media Buyer & Ad Operations Success Manager who excels in both programmatic/media buying and ad tech operations. This role is critical in ensuring the success of our advertising campaigns by optimizing media investments, managing ad tech infrastructure, and driving performance through data-driven strategies.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience in media buying (paid social, programmatic, search, or video) and a deep understanding of ad serving, tracking, and campaign troubleshooting. You will bridge the gap between media execution and technical ad ops, ensuring seamless campaign delivery and maximizing ROI.

Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Optimization:
    • Plan, execute, and optimize performance-driven media buys across platforms (Meta, Google, DSPs, etc.).
    • Manage budgets, bids, and targeting strategies to maximize campaign performance.
    • Conduct A/B testing, audience segmentation, and funnel optimization.
  • Ad Operations & Technical Management:
    • Oversee ad trafficking, tag implementation (Google Tag Manager, pixels, etc.), and QA.
    • Troubleshoot discrepancies in delivery, tracking, or attribution.
    • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to resolve technical issues.
  • Performance Analysis & Reporting:
    • Monitor KPIs (CTR, CPA, ROAS) and provide actionable insights.
    • Generate reports and present findings to stakeholders.
    • Ensure alignment between media spend and business objectives.
  • Client & Stakeholder Success:
    • Act as a trusted advisor to internal teams or clients on best practices.
    • Proactively identify opportunities for campaign improvement.

What We're Looking For

  • Analytical Thinking - Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and make data-driven decisions.
  • Technical Proficiency - Familiarity with digital advertising tools and platforms like Google Ad Manager, WordPress, GAM 360, traffic acquisition tools such as Active Campaign and header bidding solutions.
  • Problem-Solving Skills - Resourceful in identifying issues, troubleshooting errors, and finding effective solutions.
  • Attention to Detail - Precision in setting up campaigns, implementing ad tags, or managing publisher configurations to ensure optimal outcomes.
  • Communication Skills - Clarity in conveying technical details, results, and strategies to stakeholders with varying levels of understanding.
  • Client-Centric Mindset - Strong focus on understanding client needs and providing personalized solutions to maximize client satisfaction.
  • Knowledge of Ad Metrics - Understanding of key ad metrics like CPM, CPC, CTR, RPM, and ad yield optimization strategies.
  • Strategic Thinking - Ability to think ahead and align short-term actions with long-term goals, including scaling performance.
  • Sales Acumen - Skills to pitch ad solutions effectively, negotiate deals, and close partnerships with publishers or advertisers.
  • Results-Oriented - Strong drive to achieve and exceed KPIs and revenue targets.
  • Negotiation Skills - Confidence in negotiating with clients, vendors, and partners to secure the best outcomes for the business.
  • Resilience - Ability to handle challenges and setbacks while maintaining motivation and a positive attitude.
  • Data Visualization - Skills to create clear and impactful reports or dashboards to communicate performance and insights effectively.
  • AI Fluency - Understanding and practical application of AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, data enrichment tools, automated workflows) to enhance productivity, decision-making, and campaign performance.

title: SENIOR SOFTWARE ENGINEER NODE
description:
Overview

O Ton é uma empresa do grupo Stone Co., focada em empoderar empreendedores autônomos por meio de soluções financeiras como maquininhas, conta digital, cartão e programa de renda extra. Nosso time é apaixonado por desafios e movido por impacto real na vida dos nossos clientes — sempre com leveza, autonomia e muita colaboração. Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de trabalhar com um time de apaixonados por desafios, sempre preocupado em atender da melhor forma os nossos clientes e buscando as melhores escolhas técnicas para entregar os resultados. E mais importante, tudo isso em um ambiente descontraído com horário flexível e a possibilidade de trabalhar remoto.

Por aqui, vivemos nossa cultura no dia a dia, guiados por esses 5 pilares:

Own It: Ter espírito de dono te faz conquistar a liberdade. Valorizamos a autonomia e a proatividade, somos responsáveis pelo o que entregamos e queremos sempre evoluir o nosso negócio.

Live the Ride: Faça. Feito é melhor que perfeito. Aprendemos com os erros e encaramos desafios como oportunidades de aprendizado.

No Bullshit: Agir com simplicidade. Somos pessoas práticas, sinceras e gostamos de feedbacks. Sabemos que às vezes vamos errar e contamos com essa transparência para evoluirmos.

Team Play: Se quer ir rápido, vá sozinho(a). Se quer ir longe, trabalhe em equipe. É sempre possível aprender com as outras pessoas e a colaboração é a chave do sucesso.

The Reason: O cliente não tem razão, ele é a razão. Nos motivamos a enxergar o impacto do nosso trabalho na vida do cliente, é vendo que melhoramos a vida dele que sabemos que fizemos uma boa entrega.

A equipe do programa Renda Extra | TON está dedicada a transformar vidas por meio de oportunidades únicas de geração de renda. Nosso programa oferece uma maneira inovadora para os nossos parceiros, de obter uma renda adicional ou até mesmo substituir sua fonte de renda principal sem nenhum vínculo empregatício. Nosso objetivo é empoderar as pessoas, proporcionando-lhes os meios para alcançar a estabilidade financeira e crescimento pessoal.

Senior Software Engineer Node

Você terá um papel essencial na evolução do nosso ecossistema, atuando no desenvolvimento de novas funcionalidades, provas de conceito e melhorias contínuas nos nossos microsserviços e aplicações. Esperamos que você contribua ativamente desde a ideação até a entrega, participando de cerimônias, revisando código, mantendo e atualizando a documentação técnica. Fará parte de um time colaborativo, engajado em criar soluções escaláveis e de alto impacto, sempre em alinhamento com os padrões técnicos da companhia. Aqui, valorizamos opiniões, ideias novas e iniciativas — queremos que você protagonize melhorias e ajude a elevar a barra técnica do produto. Também é esperado que você compartilhe conhecimento com o time, lidere refatorações quando necessário, e participe ativamente do refinamento de demandas junto ao time de UX, garantindo entregas com qualidade e foco no cliente.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência com NodeJS, TypeScript e Jest
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura moderna: SOLID, Clean Architecture, FaaS, APIs REST/WebSocket
  • Prática com AWS (Lambda, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3 etc.) e banco NoSQL (DynamoDB)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de cache e busca (Redis, OpenSearch/ElasticSearch)
  • Git, CI/CD, documentação técnica e segurança em desenvolvimento

O que aumenta as suas chances

  • Experiência Banco de Dados relacional
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de infraestrutura em código, como Terraform
  • Habilidade de otimização para suporte de alto volume de dados
  • Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade e monitoramento como DataDog, CloudWatch e Splunk
  • Experiência com automação de Testes e testes de carga (Jest, K6, JMeter)

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde e Odontológico
  • Hospital Digital, da Vitta: com equipe médica 24/7
  • Vale Refeição e/ou Vale Alimentação
  • Auxílio Remoto + Setup Inicial (para vagas remotas)
  • Horário flexível
  • Benefício Educação - Plataforma interna com livros, podcasts, treinamentos e videoaulas
  • Auxílio Creche
  • Vale Transporte (exclusivo para vagas presenciais)

Etapas do Processo Seletivo

  1. Inscrição: Aqui você começa a sua jornada conosco. Nosso time analisará as informações do seu perfil e entrará em contato em breve.
  2. Entrevistas com o time de People: papo para conhecer nossa cultura, estrutura e o desafio proposto.
  3. Avaliação Técnica: aprofundar hard skills com possibility de dois papos ou um desafio.
  4. Check de Cultura: conversa com guardiões da cultura para alinhar crenças e visão.
  5. Feedback: compartilharemos o feedback independente do resultado.

With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

The Data Platform Team is responsible for building and maintaining system components that pave the way for data engineers and analysts to deliver their business objectives. This team leverages open-source software, uses cloud infrastructure and services, and builds software to accomplish its mission.

People on this team have different technical backgrounds, such as software engineering, systems administration (Kubernetes), cloud infrastructure and services, data analysis, and data governance.

This is an established team with a strong culture that expects collaboration, humbleness, accountability, empathy, and a sense of humor.

  • Autoscale Trino for data transformation pipelines

Há mais de 15 anos, a BairesDev é líder em projetos tecnológicos. Entregamos soluções inovadoras para gigantes como Google e Rolls-Royce e as startups mais inovadoras do Vale do Silício.

Temos uma equipe diversa de mais de 4.000 profissionais formada pelo Top 1% dos talentos de tecnologia do mundo, trabalhando remotamente em cargos de impacto global.

Ao se candidatar para este cargo, você está dando o primeiro passo em um processo que vai além do comum. Nosso objetivo é alinhar suas paixões, habilidades, e expectativas às nossas vagas, colocando você no caminho para desenvolver uma carreira de sucesso excepcional.

Tester de Software (QA) / Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento na BairesDev

Buscamos excelentes Tester de Software (QA) para se juntarem à equipe de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento (P&D) da BairesDev. Nossa equipe de P&D é uma parte essencial de nossas soluções de tecnologia que geram milhões em receita todos os anos, portanto, contratamos apenas os melhores entre os melhores.

Dentro da equipe, você encontrará muitos desafios diferentes: análise de dados, machine learning, desktop e desenvolvimentos da web são alguns dos mais relevantes no momento, mas você perceberá que coisas novas surgem todos os dias para impulsionar a inovação, A área de P&D é sem dúvida a área mais interessante e desafiadora de toda a empresa, e embora a BairesDev seja formada por pessoas realmente talentosas, aqui você encontrará profissionais com vasta experiência e também de nível intelectual e criativo, muito acima da média.

Queremos gente que curta o desafio! Você está pronto?

Responsabilidades

- Analisar os requisitos do usuário final para definir e documentar os planos de teste.

- Executar casos de teste, depurar, detectar erros e / ou possíveis melhorias, documentar e fazer o acompanhamento para serem resolvidos.

- Gerar relatórios de resultados de testes e dos erros detectados.

- Definir prioridades e planejar testes de requisitos de sistema.

- Documentar as funcionalidades dos sistemas.

- Representar o usuário final para os desenvolvedores para garantir que os requisitos sejam atendidos.

- Detectar e propor melhorias tanto no processo de controle de qualidade quanto no ciclo de desenvolvimento de software.

Esperamos que você tenha:

- 4+ anos de experiência em testes de Produtos Web.

- Sólidos conhecimentos em ferramentas de teste.

- Desenvolvimento de planos de teste: criação de casos de teste e depuração.

- Conhecimento adicional em tecnologias web.

- Amplo conhecimento em ambientes Unix e Linux.

- Nível avançado de inglês.

Como tornamos seu trabalho (e sua vida) mais fácil:

- Modalidade 100% remota - trabalhe de qualquer lugar.

- Excelente remuneração em USD ou na sua moeda local, como preferir.

- Hardware para você trabalhar de casa.

- Horários flexíveis - faça seu próprio horário.

- Licença parental remunerada, férias, e feriados nacionais.

- Ambiente de trabalho inovador e multicultural.

- Colabore e aprenda com o Top 1% global dos talentos de cada área.

- Ambiente de apoio com mentoria, promoções, desenvolvimento de habilidades, e diversas oportunidades de crescimento.

Junte-se a uma equipe global onde seus talentos excepcionais podem se destacar!

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the LATAM region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the LATAM region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

Company overview

Docusign brings agreements to life. Over 1.5 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. Preferred

  • Ability to troubleshoot regular expressions and other complex data validation rules
  • Expertise with web-based applications, web service APIs, monitoring tools (e.g., Dynatrace), and authentication technologies such as SAML and OAuth

  • Ability to maintain composure in critical situations and communicate clearly with both internal and external customers

Working here

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

Overview

Quer ajudar a construir uma sociedade mais justa e solidária?

O Grupo Marista está em busca de um profissional que deseje que seu dia a dia de trabalho seja repleto de significado e preenchido pelo propósito de fazer parte de uma missão que impacta positivamente a vida de quem mais precisa, por meio da educação e do cuidado com a saúde. Acredita que esse propósito está alinhado com as suas perspectivas de carreira? Então venha construir conosco o futuro profissional que você deseja. Esta é uma vaga de Banco de Talentos, inscreva-se aqui para oportunidades em todas as nossas frentes de negócios.

Main responsibilities

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Esse é um Banco de Talentos direcionado para profissionais que possuem interesse em compor o Time da Graduação EAD da PUCPR como Professor-Tutor.

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Realizar atendimentos individuais via chat no AVA;
  • Realizar webconferências síncronas com seus estudantes;
  • Preparar e gravar vídeos com orientações e explanações relacionadas às suas disciplinas e atividades;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento dos estudantes ao longo das semanas de estudo;
  • Corrigir atividades avaliativas de suas disciplinas, garantindo a adesão dos estudantes às mesmas;
  • Realizar contatos com os estudantes de suas turmas;
  • Atender demandas da área relacionadas às suas disciplinas e envolvimento com os cursos e área;
  • Dar atendimento pedagógico e operacional aos estudantes;
  • Participar de capacitações internas;

Requirements and skills

Este é um banco de talentos, podendo ou não haver contratações. Abaixo estão as áreas de interesse focais.

Teologia:

  • Formação obrigatória em Teologia.
  • Titulação: doutorado completo.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Serviço Social:

  • Formação obrigatória em Serviço Social.
  • Titulação: doutorado completo.
  • Segunda formação em Teologia, Filosofia ou área de Negócios.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Tecnologia e Informação:

  • Formação em cursos de tecnologia ou engenharia.
  • Titulação mínima: mestrado completo. Preferencialmente doutorado.
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em área de Programação e Inteligência Artificial.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Logística:

  • Logística: obrigatória formação em Logística.
  • Titulação: Doutorado.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Demais Áreas:

  • Outras áreas de formação e perfis de profissionais poderão ser analisados conforme necessidade perante demanda.
  • Titulação: mestrado completo. Preferencialmente doutorado.
  • Experiência comprovada com tutoria/docência em cursos de graduação EAD.

Additional information

description:
Join to apply for the Engenheiro a de facilities role at Netvagas

Engenheiro (a) de Facilities

Resumo: Buscamos um Engenheiro(a) de Facilities para atuar na gestão e manutenção da infraestrutura industrial e predial da empresa, garantindo operação segura, eficiente e alinhada às normas de HSE. O profissional será responsável por supervisionar utilidades, manutenção preventiva e corretiva, gestão de fornecedores e contratos, além de liderar equipes e projetos de melhoria contínua.

Responsabilidades

  • Supervisionar a operação, manutenção e melhorias de instalações industriais, administrativas e de apoio (prédios, oficinas, depósitos, estacionamentos, áreas verdes).
  • Garantir a disponibilidade e eficiência dos sistemas de utilidades, como elétrica, hidráulica, HVAC, GNV, água, esgoto e tratamento de resíduos.
  • Planejar e gerenciar projetos de expansão, reforma ou retrofit de instalações.
  • Desenvolver planos de manutenção preventiva, preditiva e corretiva para os ativos de facilities.
  • Analisar indicadores de performance (KPIs) de manutenção e propor ações de melhoria contínua.
  • Implementar programas de eficiência energética e sustentabilidade nas operações.
  • Garantir que todas as atividades de facilities estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança, saúde ocupacional e legislação ambiental.
  • Participar de auditorias internas e externas relacionadas a HSE e infraestrutura.
  • Promover cultura de segurança entre prestadores de serviços e colaboradores.
  • Selecionar, acompanhar e avaliar prestadores de serviços e fornecedores de facilities.
  • Gerir contratos, escopos e custos relacionados a manutenção, reformas e serviços terceirizados.
  • Elaborar e controlar o orçamento anual da área de facilities.
  • Planejar investimentos estratégicos em infraestrutura e melhorias de eficiência operacional.
  • Liderar equipes internas e coordenar prestadores de serviços terceirizados.
  • Promover desenvolvimento técnico e comportamental da equipe.
  • Garantir comunicação eficiente e alinhamento com demais áreas da empresa.

Escolaridade

  • Graduação Completa
  • Formação em Engenharia Civil

Tipo de Experiência

  • 6 meses de experiência na mesma área.

Competências Técnicas

  • Conhecimento em sistemas prediais (elétrico, hidráulico, HVAC), normas técnicas e regulatórias
  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos em facilities ou manutenção industrial, preferencialmente em Óleo & Gas.

Competências Comportamentais

  • Habilidades de liderança, planejamento, comunicação e foco em resultados

Outros Requisitos (desejável)

  • Inglês intermediário
  • Experiência com projetos de eficiência energética e sustentabilidade
  • Vivência em gestão de contratos e fornecedores

Se tiver dúvidas, entre em contato pelo e-mail. Desejamos boa sorte.

Da nossa sede em Goiânia e unidades em São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Patos de Minas, Curitiba e Belém, avançamos por todo o Brasil transformando desafios dos maiores segmentos econômicos em informações de valor e aprendizado para todos os envolvidos. Somos um verdadeiro oceano de oportunidades para os alinhados com a nossa cultura, porque se tem uma coisa que nós nunca, jamais, em hipótese alguma vamos abrir mão é da cultura que nos trouxe até aqui. Tudo isso pode até parecer exagero, mas nossos colaboradores são a prova de que, aqui, o impossível se torna possível. São nossas responsabilidades sociais, ambientais e de governança que nos guiam em direção ao extraordinário, e pode ter certeza que, durante o caminho, você terá recursos e treinamentos para se tornar especialista no que precisa ser feito e entregar o que precisa ser entregue. E assim como você, entendemos o poder das decisões, principalmente aquelas que, embora difíceis, precisam ser tomadas. Então, escolha hoje ser o protagonista da sua vida e o dono da sua própria carreira! Bem-vindo à Planning!

  • AWS cloud platform: Familiarity with core AWS services (EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM).
  • Version control: Experience with Git.

Sobre nós

Somos uma startup recifense focada no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais inovadoras que geram impacto real no setor público. Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um Tech Lead para integrar nossa equipe. Seu papel será liderar tecnicamente o desenvolvimento do nosso produto de gerenciamento de atendimento (Service Management), construído sobre nossa plataforma low-code. O desafio é guiar o time na criação de uma solução robusta e escalável, promovendo inovação e excelência técnica.

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir o alinhamento técnico entre times e especialistas, assegurando coesão arquitetural e boas práticas.
  • Avaliar e apoiar decisões técnicas em frontend (Vue.js), backend (Node.js, Express), banco de dados (MySQL) e cloud (GCP), em conjunto com especialistas de cada área.
  • Definir e documentar diretrizes arquiteturais, priorizando escalabilidade, eficiência e segurança.
  • Mentorar o time de desenvolvimento, incentivando boas práticas e a troca de conhecimento entre áreas.
  • Atuar como ponte entre desenvolvimento, produto e design, alinhando soluções técnicas aos objetivos estratégicos.
  • Planejar, delegar e acompanhar atividades, equilibrando prazos e qualidade.

Principais desafios

  • Evoluir nosso UI Builder: Participar da evolução do construtor de componentes e páginas, que permite criar telas e fluxos completos utilizando recursos do Vue.js por meio de interface, com alguns cliques e poucas linhas de código. Nosso objetivo é trazer a experiência de codar para o UI Builder, permitindo que até páginas mais complexas possam ser construídas nele.
  • Desenvolver nossa solução white label: Contribuir para a evolução do motor de criação de plataformas white label, que oferece funcionalidades nativas como autenticação, gerenciamento de usuários, permissões, construtor de formulários, CRUD de tabelas SQL via interface, CSM, entre outras. Tudo isso em um ambiente isolado para cada cliente, com possibilidade de customizações específicas.
  • Aprimorar nosso marketplace de páginas: Criar e expandir o marketplace que permite a publicação, instalação e gestão de páginas desenvolvidas em Vue, compartilháveis entre diferentes clientes do nosso ecossistema.
  • Expandir nossa biblioteca de componentes: Desenvolver componentes únicos e reutilizáveis, como formulários dinâmicos, calendários, gráficos Gantt, listas com integração nativa a APIs etc.
  • Desenvolver soluções de IA e Machine Learning: Criar fluxos com LLMs, integrando funções acionáveis em contextos específicos (como consultas em banco de dados). Implementar RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) por meio de vetorização de dados, buscas por similaridade e integração com LLM.
  • Automatizar com fluxos low-code/no-code: Implementar soluções usando ferramentas como N8N e ActivePieces, construindo fluxos e APIs completas via interface. Também criar novos nós reutilizáveis por toda a equipe de desenvolvimento.
  • Contribuir para o open source: Apoiar a abertura dos nossos produtos para a comunidade, fomentando colaboração global e ampliando o impacto das soluções.

Informações adicionais

  • Contratação PJ.
  • Trabalho remoto, com encontros presenciais ocasionais em Recife (valorizamos esses momentos, mas não são uma exigência).
  • Horários flexíveis, com foco em resultados.

  • Impacto positivo real: Nossos produtos transformam áreas como educação, saúde e direito.
  • Crescimento acelerado: Investimos no seu desenvolvimento por meio de cursos, workshops e eventos.

  • Knowledge of Itential automation tools and Ansible.
  • Experience with network monitoring tools such as Solar Winds, Thousand Eyes, Pingdom, or Splunk.

Company Overview

Dadosfera is transforming the data landscape with a platform that delivers advanced Data, AI, and Analytics capabilities—previously available only to tech giants like Meta, Amazon, Alphabet, and Microsoft—into the hands of small and medium-sized businesses. By democratizing access to these technologies, we empower our clients to accelerate business opportunities through AI-powered Data Apps.

Our platform minimizes the time spent on cloud management and streamlines the entire data lifecycle—from collection and exploration to processing and interaction—allowing clients to focus on their business goals. Built on a high-growth SaaS model, Dadosfera offers tailored solutions that meet real business needs.

What sets Dadosfera apart is our innovative focus on speed, scalability, and flexibility, combining big data storage with advanced analytics to drive strategic decision-making. Leveraging years of experience with data platform implementations on foreign public clouds, we now deliver a cost-effective, locally adapted solution tailored for both Brazilian and global markets. By blending deep expertise with localized infrastructure, Dadosfera provides a powerful, efficient tool that optimizes corporate data management and drives data-driven transformation.

About the Job

At Dadosfera, we’re building a robust and scalable data platform that empowers organizations to make data-driven decisions with confidence. As a Senior Back-end Engineer , you will play a key role in automating critical product and infrastructure processes—specifically around deployment, billing, usage tracking, and continuous improvements .

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement back-end solutions to support automated deployment workflows, infrastructure improvements, and scalability
  • Develop and maintain automated billing and usage tracking systems in a multi-tenant SaaS environment
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and data teams to continuously evolve the architecture of our platform
  • Ensure high code quality through clean code practices, peer reviews, and testing (TDD/CI/CD)
  • Build and manage infrastructure as code using tools like Terraform and Kubernetes
  • Improve observability, reliability, and security across services
  • Contribute to the definition and documentation of technical standards and best practices

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in software development in production environments
  • Solid experience with Kubernetes (cluster management, Helm charts, troubleshooting)
  • Hands-on with Terraform (module writing, state management, workspaces)
  • Cloud experience with at least one provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) – including IAM and networking
  • Strong understanding of API design (REST or GraphQL), authentication (OAuth, JWT), and versioning
  • Proficient in unit and integration testing, with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, etc.)
  • Strong knowledge of Clean Code, SOLID principles, DDD, code reviews, and pair programming
  • Comfortable with Docker (image optimization, registry management)
  • Proficient in Git and common branching strategies (GitFlow, trunk-based)
  • Ability to read technical documentation and write specs in English
  • Experience with SaaS product development (billing, subscriptions, multi-tenancy)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Previous role as a startup founder or CTO
  • Familiarity with observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/EFK)
  • Experience in event-driven architectures (Kafka, RabbitMQ, pub/sub)
  • Knowledge of resilient microservice patterns (circuit breaker, retries)
  • Understanding of application security principles (OWASP, network policies, vulnerability scanning)
  • Contributions to open source projects
  • Exposure to data infrastructure tools such as Airflow or Spark, and/or experience with Data & AI platforms

About Monetize More

Monetize More is a leading ad-tech company dedicated to empowering digital publishers to maximize their ad revenue through innovative technology and strategic partnerships. Our cutting-edge platform optimizes ad layouts, leverages header bidding, and integrates advanced analytics to drive superior results for publishers worldwide. Headquartered in Canada with a strong presence in the APAC region, we’re looking for a dynamic Commissioned Sales Representative to join our high-performing team and help publishers thrive in the digital advertising ecosystem.

Job Overview

As a Commissioned Sales Representative at MonetizeMore, you will be the face of our brand in the LATAM region, driving new business by identifying, engaging, and converting publisher leads into long-term clients. This role starts as a commission-only position, offering uncapped earning potential for high performers. Upon consistently meeting sales targets, you will transition to a competitive fixed salary plus commission structure, rewarding your success with stability and growth opportunities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead Generation and Prospecting: Identify and target high-potential publishers in the LATAM region through research, networking, and industry events.
  • Client Engagement: Build and maintain strong relationships with publishers, understanding their needs and presenting tailored ad-tech solutions from Monetize More.
  • Sales Conversion: Drive the full sales cycle from initial outreach to closing deals, leveraging product demos, proposals, and negotiations to secure partnerships.
  • Market Representation: Represent MonetizeMore at industry conferences, webinars, and networking events, establishing the company as a trusted leader in ad-tech.
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the account management and technical teams to ensure seamless onboarding and optimization for new clients.
  • Reporting and Analytics: Track sales performance using CRM tools, providing regular updates on pipeline progress and market insights to leadership.
  • Market Intelligence: Stay informed on LATAM ad-tech trends, competitor offerings, and publisher needs to refine sales strategies.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of B2B sales experience, preferably in ad-tech, digital advertising, or SaaS industries.
  • Industry Knowledge: Familiarity with digital advertising concepts such as header bidding, programmatic advertising, ad optimization, and publisher monetization.
  • Skills:
    • Proven ability to generate and close leads in a competitive market.
    • Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
    • Proficiency with CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot) and sales analytics.
    • Self-motivated with a strong drive to succeed in a commission-based environment.
  • Regional Expertise: Understanding of the LATAMdigital publishing landscape, with fluency in English and preferably one additional LATAM language (Portuguese, Spanish, French).
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field (preferred but not mandatory).

Compensation Structure

  • 0–$10,000 Monthly Revenue: 10% commission.
  • $10,001–$25,000 Monthly Revenue: 12% commission.
  • $25,001–$50,000 Monthly Revenue: 15% commission.
  • $50,001+ Monthly Revenue: 18% commission.
Note: Commissions are calculated based on the revenue generated from new client acquisitions and are paid monthly.

Why Join Monetize More?

  • Innovative Environment: Work with a leading ad-tech platform that empowers publishers to succeed.
  • Uncapped Earnings: Maximize your income through a lucrative commission structure designed for high performers.
  • Career Growth: Transition to a salaried role with opportunities to advance into leadership positions.
  • Impactful Work: Help publishers in the APAC region unlock their full revenue potential with cutting-edge technology.
  • Team Culture: Join a passionate, collaborative team with a global presence and a commitment to excellence.

description:
This range is provided by LawnStarter. Your actual pay will be based on your skills and experience — talk with your recruiter to learn more.

Base pay range

$60,000.00/yr - $70,000.00/yr

As a Sr. Product Data Analyst, you'll be directly impacting our results through insights and reports. You'll be working close to product managers, researchers, and other business stakeholders, helping with prioritization, assessments, and business recommendations. It will be your responsibility, alongside the Analytics team, to nurture the data-driven culture within the company, making data easier to consume, be it through interactive reports, easy-to-use datasets, documentation, training.

Help Us Build the Future of Outdoor Services

At LawnStarter, we are transforming the $100B+ outdoor home services industry—making it easier for homeowners to book, manage, and enjoy services like lawn care, landscaping, and more. With $30M+ in venture funding and solid traction, we are investing in the next generation of our platform—and we are looking for a Senior Product Data Analyst to help drive it.

See what we are building!

Problems to be solved

Your primary responsibility will be to empower our organization to be more data-driven, with multiple avenues to accomplish that, such as:

  • Modeling & Analysis: A marketplace is a complex system with various moving parts and often conflicting signals. This creates opportunities to identify gaps, insights, or optimizations. The analyses and models may range from simple AB tests to multivariate models on retention or ETA. You should have advanced experience in SQL and intermediate experience in Python or R.
  • Reporting: A complex system creates many metrics to track for running the business efficiently. You will work with teams to understand their needs and help the Analytics team create and maintain a reliable, user-friendly reporting system, primarily using Tableau and Metabase.
  • Analytics Engineering: Occasionally you will work on the inner layers of our Data Warehouse to provide clean and documented datasets for reports and end users. Understanding business needs and translating them into our DW is crucial; we use DBT for data transformation, so SQL experience is a must.

Requirements

  • Experience: 4+ years in data & analytics at data-driven companies
  • Education: STEM or business background or relevant education that enables you to empower the organization to be more data-driven
  • Learning Mindset: You take pride in understanding problems deeply, asking the right questions, and approaching problems with structure and logic. You adapt to the business as needed rather than applying a fixed process blindly.
  • Team player: You collaborate effectively with others and create an environment where people are excited to work with you, with intellectual honesty and trust
  • Business focus: You understand how your analysis connects with product, customers, and financials, and can drill down metrics from top to bottom as needed
  • Bias for action: You balance careful analysis with getting things done, avoiding unnecessary perfectionism or rigid full-solution builds before validating with real use

VERY IMPORTANT REMINDER: Please upload your English resume—applications without it will not be considered.

Benefits

  • Salary range: $60-$70k USD annually
  • Work from anywhere
  • Flexible hours—complete work on your schedule
  • Unlimited PTO — Focus on results. Take time you need to recharge or work hard when you return

LawnStarter is building the future of outdoor home services. Want to help us shape it?
Apply now and let's grow together.

noisaac, vivemos desafios grandiosos e instigantes, construindo um produto totalmente do zero. Nosso ponto de partida é sempre a investigação profunda dos reais problemas de escolas e responsáveis, para então idealizar e colocar em prática soluções simples, escaláveis e de alto impacto.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Frontend Software Engineer Specialist to join our BASE FA Teams in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

At the BASE (Business Architecture Services), we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support millions of active users and clients around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models.

You will be involved from the beginning of the product lifecycle, partnering with product and design, defining technical approaches, and delivering high-impact solutions. Your work will ensure performance, reliability, and overall product excellence across BASE services.

This role combines strong frontend expertise with leadership in a critical position that delivers meaningful impact across the organization, spanning from system architecture to implementation.

  • Lead the frontend development in the BASE Focus Area, influencing architecture and design decisions across teams.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A specialist frontend software engineer with strong expertise in React and React Native , along with a solid understanding of related technologies.
  • Experienced in distributed systems and modern system designs, including cloud environments, CI/CD pipelines, Backend for Frontend (BFFs), Micro Frontends, as well as web and mobile applications.

  • Capable of architecting large-scale, multi-tier web applications.
  • A team player who thrives in collaborative environments, providing mentorship to junior colleagues and actively seeking support from peers.
  • An effective communicator, both written and verbal, able to clearly articulate ideas across cultures and geographies in both Portuguese and English.
  • A professional with strong desire for learning and self-development, holding a bachelor’s degree in computer science or possessing equivalent professional experience.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don’t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, prior experience in React and React Native are mandatory requirement.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We’re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

  • WELLHUB: Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.
  • WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.
  • FLEXIBLE WORK: Flexible hybrid or full remote work models, home office stipend, and monthly flexible work allowance.
  • FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Flexibility to adjust working hours based on personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.
  • PAID TIME OFF: Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day per year of tenure (up to 5 extra days) + birthday off.
  • PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.
  • CAREER GROWTH: Opportunities for personal and career growth and investment in employee development.
  • CULTURE: An exciting and supportive global workplace with a value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity.

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis required by law.

title: Senior Engineer, Remote Support (IDC)
description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility -our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how thework we do changes the world for the better.

We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!

Job Description

The primary responsibility of the Senior Engineer - Systems Technical Support position is to remotely provide support for server and storage equipment located at customer sites. You will work in the server environment. We ask that you have self-initiative, ownership, a desire to follow issues to resolution, commercial sensitivity, responsiveness, collaboration, and technical expertise.

You will report to the Supervisor Managed Services

Main location: Bogota, Colombia. We can consider other cities.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • You will focus on remote managed services for data centers located in manufacturing facilities. Have technical expertise for computer environments and will be instrumental in bridging the industrial and information technology paradigms.
  • You will support modifying and maintaining Windows Server Operating Systems, Active Directory and Directory Services, and performance monitoring techniques on server software and hardware.
  • You will support many VMware products such as vCenter, ESXi versions 6.x+, HorizonView, vSAN and must have experience managing these environments in a production environment.
  • Provide troubleshooting assistance remotely by telephone and email on products to Rockwell Automation field service personnel, distributors, integrators, and customers. Work with other engineers, manage and deal with high pressure situations.
  • Investigate and verify reported product problems in software, firmware, hardware and documentation. Document the problem, work with appropriate group to resolve the problem, and follow up with the Rockwell Automation representative or customer when the problem is solved.
  • Provides documentation of all actions taken in the appropriate systems, set expectations with customers and follow-up on an action item or activity needed to resolve a problem being experienced by a customer. You will update and author Technical Notes and other documentation to inform Rockwell Automation personnel, domestic or international, of solutions to commonly experienced problems, work around, installation practices that create problems to improve customer satisfaction and acceptance.

BASIC REQUIREMENTS:

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, computer science, information technology, computer programming, or similar.

PREFERRED REQUIREMENTS:

  • VMWare Certified Professional (VCP).
  • 3 years' experience as a VMware engineer.
  • Proficiency in VMware associated programs and coding languages, such as Windows Server, MS IIS, SAN/vSAN architectures.
  • Knowledge of the fundamentals of VMware solutions and related technologies.
  • Programming Language for cloud platforms: Python, Java, JavaScript, Power Shell
  • Exceptional analytical and technical skills.
  • Availability to resolve urgent VMware environment problems outside of business hours.
  • Familiarity with network and SAN switching technologies.
  • Good English reading, writing and verbal communication skills
  • Strict adherence to company standards and procedures.
  • Excellent trouble shooting skills
What We Offer:

Our benefits package includes …

  • Comprehensive mindfulness programs with a premium membership to Calm
  • Volunteer Paid Time off available after 6 months of employment for eligible employees.
  • Company volunteer and donation matching program – Your volunteer hours or personal cash donations to an eligible charity can be matched with a charitable donation.
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Personalized wellbeing programs through our OnTrack program
  • On-demand digital course library for professional development... and other local benefits!

We believe that employee diversity is an important element of our common future. We provide opportunities for talent growth with the entire organization. We support equality by celebrating the individuality of every person, regardless of their origin and identity. We appreciate the unique cultural pattern and variety of experiences in each of us. We invite all who want to join and change the world of our organization.

title: QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services
description:
QA Engineer Specialist | Business Architecture Services

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.
*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!
We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.
THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a QA Engineer Specialist in our BASE area in Brazil! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country.
At the BASE (Business Architecture Services) Focus Area, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users and clients around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models. In this role, you will go beyond testing — you will drive quality across services and teams, mentoring engineers, shaping automation frameworks, and ensuring Wellhub continues to deliver reliable, scalable, and user-centric solutions.
As a Q.A. Engineer you will take end-to-end ownership of the quality of the most critical product flows and deliveries. You will be involved from the very beginning of the product lifecycle, helping with the product requirements, defining and building comprehensive test scenarios, performing in-depth exploratory testing, and automating mission-critical flows. Your work will ensure backward compatibility, performance, reliability, and overall product excellence.In addition, you will define and continuously improve the testing pipeline, driving best practices in automated testing and mentoring developers to elevate the team’s quality standards.
This role combines strong analytical QA expertise with engineering skills in a critical position that delivers meaningful impact across the organization, spanning from overall test planning to execution.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Lead the design and implementation of test strategies (manual, automated, and exploratory) for complex distributed systems.
  • Define and evolve quality standards, frameworks, and processes across multiple services.
  • Mentor and guide software engineers, fostering a culture of ownership for quality.
  • Partner with product managers and engineering leaders to assess risks, define acceptance criteria, and shape solutions.
  • Drive test automation adoption, building scalable frameworks for APIs, backend services, and integrations.
  • Champion performance, load, and reliability testing as part of the development lifecycle.
  • Ensure quality gates and CI/CD pipelines provide fast, reliable feedback to teams.
  • Identify systemic quality issues and propose improvements in architecture, tooling, and processes.
  • Act as a quality advocate, ensuring we deliver not just working software, but trusted and delightful experiences to users.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • A QA professional with a bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Solid experience in QA Engineering, with a strong background in automation (Cypress, Playwright, Rest-assured, SuperTest, Bruno, Cucumber, Postman, or similar).
  • Experienced with API testing (REST/GraphQL) and data validations in SQL/NoSQL databases.
  • Familiar with cloud-native environments (AWS/GCP) and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Preferred but not required experience in performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling, Locust, K6) and their application to large-scale systems.
  • Experienced in risk-based testing, exploratory testing, and working with distributed systems.
  • Solid experience working with distributed systems using asynchronous communication (Kafka)
  • Familiar with SQL, being able to navigate complex data domains
  • Comfortable leading cross-team initiatives, influencing quality practices, and driving alignment on testing strategies.
  • Solid communication skills in English, able to articulate quality goals, trade-offs, and improvements across cultures and geographies.
  • A proactive, collaborative problem-solver who sees quality as a shared responsibility across engineering.
  • Experience with observability tools (Datadog, NewRelic, Kibana, Prometheus, Grafana Loki, or similar).
  • Preferred but not required experience with contract testing (Pact, Spring Cloud Contract, Dredd, or similar).

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don't match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team. For this specific role, please note that prior experience in QA Engineering, automation test, API testing, and distributed systems using asynchronous communicationare mandatory requirements

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. You will receive the Gold plan at no cost, and other premium plans will be significantly discounted.

WELLNESS: Health, dental, and life insurance.

FLEXIBLE WORK: At Wellhub, flexibility fosters a happier, healthier, and more productive work environment for everyone. As a Flexible First company, we offer two work model options: flexible hybrid and full remote, and make the office a place for collaboration, community, and team building. The model for this role can be discussed with your recruiter and hiring manager. We offer all employees a home office stipend and a monthly flexible work allowance to help cover the costs of working from home.

FLEXIBLE SCHEDULE: Wellhubbers and their leaders can make the best decisions for their scope. This includes flexibility to adjust their working hours based on their personal schedule, time zone, and business needs.

PAID TIME OFF: We know how important it is that our employees take time away from work to recharge.

Vacations after 6 months and 3 days off per year + 1 day off for each year of tenure (up to 5 additional days) + extra day off for your birthday.

PAID PARENTAL LEAVE: Welcoming a new child is one of the most special moments in your life and we want our employees to take the time to be present and enjoy their growing family. We offer 100% paid parental leave to all new parents and extended maternity leave.

CAREER GROWTH: Outstanding opportunities for personal and career growth. That means we maintain a growth mindset in everything we do and invest deeply in employee development.

CULTURE: An exciting and supportive atmosphere with ambitious people from around the world! You’ll partner with global colleagues and share in the success of a high-growth technology company disrupting the health and wellness space. Our value-based culture of trust, flexibility, and integrity makes this possible every day. Find more info on our careers page !

And to get a glimpse of life at Wellhub… Follow us on Instagram @lifeatwellhub and LinkedIn !

Diversity, Equity, and Belonging at Wellhub

We aim to create a collaborative, supportive, and inclusive space where everyone knows they belong.

Wellhub is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law.

Your wellbeing matters. Join a company that cares.

GET TO KNOW US

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company. Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub! We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners.

We are hiring a Mid-level Software Engineer to join our BASE Focus Area (Tagus team) in Brazil! This is a Remote position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

At the Tagus team, we build the heart of the Wellhub business model. Our mission is to help Wellhub build a truly scalable platform to support dozens of millions of active users, clients, and partners around the world with high availability while being flexible and extensible to incorporate new business models.

We have many important challenges such as building a system that gives us the flexibility to have different commercial conditions for different users in different contexts. Also, we are responsible for some critical and important flows within our business model, such as clients\' and users\' subscriptions as well as providing data to the ecosystem as the source of truth of these entities.

When it comes to technical challenges, our team works to provide highly scalable solutions, handling large volumes of data and focusing on high availability. Considering our services central role, you’re going to have the opportunity to help drive architecture decisions that impact our whole microservices ecosystem and you will have opportunities to develop both leadership and technical skills, depending on your career aspirations and abilities.

Your impact

  • Participate in the development of some of the most critical and challenging services in our ecosystem, seeking to build long-term and sustainable solutions.
  • Design, develop, test, deploy, maintain and improve services focusing on performance, scalability, and resilience;
  • Build integration with 3rd party API and tools;
  • Support existing systems looking to enhance functionality, increase scale, and transform in new ways to meet our product demands;
  • Work in a collaborative and agile environment that prioritizes people over process and is laser-focused on productivity;
  • Work with cutting-edge technologies and edge cases on a global scale.
  • Live the mission: inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

Who you are

  • An engineer with a bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent professional experience;
  • Experienced in architecting large-scale multi-tier web applications;

  • Experienced in Cloud-based architectures (AWS / GCP);

  • Experienced in applying computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithm design, problem-solving, and complexity analysis;
  • Experienced in working with SQL/NoSQL technology such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, DynamoDB understanding common use cases and performance pitfalls
  • Proficient in one or more programming languages (Java/Ruby/Go/C++/etc.). Golang will be considered a plus;
  • Communication skills to work with multidisciplinary teams located in several countries with different cultures;
  • You need to be able to articulate ideas clearly when speaking to groups in English.

We recognize that individuals approach job applications differently. We strongly encourage all aspiring applicants to go for it, even if they don\'t match the job description 100%. We welcome your application and will be delighted to explore if you could be a great fit for our team

What we offer you

We\'re a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. Access onsite gyms and fitness studios, digital fitness programs, and online wellness resources for meditation, nutrition, mental health support, and more. description:

O Promotor de Merchandising é na linha de frente com os nossos clientes representando a Coty e fazendo com que os nossos produtos estejam sempre disponíveis para os nossos consumidores.

  • Reposição de mercadoria

Benefícios

  • Plano de Saúde

Sobre a Coty

Fundada em Paris em 1904, a Coty é uma das maiores empresas de beleza do mundo. Com portfólio de marcas consagradas em fragrâncias, maquiagens e esmaltes, cuidados com pele e corpo, a empresa atende clientes em todo o mundo e está presente em cerca de 130 países. A Coty e as suas marcas estimulam o empoderamento das pessoas para que se expressem livresmente, criando suas próprias visões de beleza; além de serem comprometidas em fomentar positivo impacto no planeta.

No Brasil, o Grupo Coty conta com aproximadamente 2,4 mil funcionários alocados em suas empresas, localizadas no Estado de São Paulo (área de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento e sede administrativa); no Estado de Goiás (fábrica Savoy e o principal centro de distribuição); e no Estado do Rio de Janeiro (centro de distribuição).

Localmente, fabricamos e comercializamos milhões de produtos todos os anos, de nossas tradicionais marcas brasileiras - como Risqué, Monange, Bozzano, Paixão, Cenoura & Bronze e outras muito conhecidas pelos brasileiros. Além disso, também comercializamos nossas fragrâncias internacionais, licenciadas de famosas marcas (Calvin Klein, Lacoste, Hugo Boss, Chloé, Burberry, Gucci, Tiffany, entre outras); e produtos de maquiagem e skincare, com Kylie Cosmetics e Kylie Skin.

Na Coty, acreditamos que hoje ninguém pode controlar ou deve ditar o que é ou não bonito. Estamos em busca de uma nova era de beleza - uma em que, juntos, a cocriamos de maneira que você possa se expressar da forma que desejar. Como companhia dessa indústria, nosso propósito é viabilizar, conjuntamente, todas as visões de beleza.

O conceito de beleza não é fixo; é algo fluido, como a água – em constante evolução e adaptação. Não é singular, e sim plural. É hora de desconstruir todos os conceitos de beleza.

Tornamos ‘fearless kindness’ ( sem medo de ser gentil, gentileza destemida ) a base dos nossos valores, porque sabemos que agora, mais do que nunca, o mundo precisa de gentileza. É um atributo e uma ação que tem um efeito de ondulação que irradia muito - gentileza para consigo mesmo, gentileza para com os outros e gentileza para com o planeta.

Portanto, hoje e todos os dias, junte-se a nós para fazer da ‘fearless kindness’ a base para suas decisões e ações; juntos, vamos causar impacto positivo no nosso próprio bem-estar mental e daqueles que nos rodeiam.

Queremos PROFISSIONAIS DIVERSOS no nosso time!

Acreditamos que vivências diferentes tornam o time vencedor. Por isso, nossas oportunidades são para todos, independentemente de raça, religião, cor, nacionalidade, idade, gênero, deficiência, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão de gênero, estado civil ou qualquer outra característica. Ou seja, valorizamos exatamente quem VOCÊ é!

  • Ability to work well in teams and interact effectively with others

  • Big data tools such as Hadoop, Spark or Kafka
  • Orchestration tools such as Airflow
  • NoSQL databases
  • Containerization technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes
  • Agile development environment and familiarity with Agile methodologies

Why TELUS Digital?

At TELUS Digital, you’ll work with world-class brands like FOX, HBO, PepsiCo, and Domino's, building transformative digital products that impact millions. Our global reach allows you to collaborate with diverse, international teams, solving complex problems and delivering tech-driven solutions that matter.

We thrive on engineering excellence, using the latest technologies in cloud computing, AI, machine learning, DevOps, microservices architecture, and data engineering. Our teams embrace Agile methodologies, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, and a DevOps-first mindset to deliver solutions at scale.

title: Medical Specialist
description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider for major technology companies and leaders in various industries including financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced ML/AI technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we are helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.

Aqui, você participará, de maneira direta ou indireta, da criação de novas soluções para os mais diversos serviços de saúde, pois essa é a missão diária de todos nós na Funcional. Pesquisamos, criamos e fazemos acontecer, pois isso está em nosso DNA.

Main responsibilities

Sua missão como Analista de Ciências de Dados será:

  • Desenvolver análises estatísticas e modelos preditivos para identificar padrões de comportamento e apoiar decisões estratégicas.
  • Estruturar hipóteses de negócio e validar estatisticamente seus impactos.
  • Explorar e tratar grandes volumes de dados de saúde, garantindo qualidade e consistência.
  • Colaborar com times de engenharia de dados e visualização de dados para disponibilizar análises e modelos em escala.
  • Elaborar relatórios e apresentações que traduzam resultados complexos em insights claros para áreas de negócio.
  • Acompanhar o desempenho dos modelos estatísticos e propor melhorias contínuas.

Requirements and skills

Habilidades que esperamos que você possua:

  • Formação em Estatística, Matemática Aplicada, Ciência de Dados ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia em análise estatística e modelagem preditiva.
  • Conhecimento sólido em estatística aplicada (testes de hipóteses, regressões, modelos probabilísticos);
  • Linguagens de programação: Python (pandas, scikit-learn, statsmodels) e R;
  • SQL para manipulação de bases de dados relacionais.

Diferenciais que vão fazer você chamar nossa atenção:

  • Experiência no setor de saúde será um diferencial (dados de operadoras, indústria farmacêutica ou varejo farmacêutico).
  • Noções de machine learning avançado e técnicas de modelagem preditiva.
  • Experiência com ambientes em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de versionamento de código (Git).

Additional information

Como é trabalhar aqui na Funcional Health Tech:

  • Nosso time é incrível, colaboramos e fazemos juntos para ir mais longe.
  • Nossa cultura é ágil e estamos em constante evolução.
  • Incentivamos o crescimento profissional e o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores com diversas ações e encontros, através de plataforma de treinamentos e webinars mensais, além da “Baratona”, que é o nosso Hackathon interno.

A Funcional reconhece que a diversidade traz benefícios para o negócio e que um ambiente plural e colaborativo é propício para a inovação acontecer. Desta forma, nossas oportunidades abraçam todos os talentos, sem distinção de cor, raça, gênero ou qualquer condição de deficiência. Todos os talentos podem participar igualitariamente nos processos seletivos da Funcional. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

Estamos em busca de um novo ou nova colega para atuar com foco em Product Manager , dentro do time de Produto. ️

Possuímos mais de 12 mil clientes em todo Brasil e somos um dos líderes de mercado para software de gestão de restaurantes em nuvem! Além disso, somos um dos maiores parceiros integrados ao iFood no Brasil sendo uma das Super Integradoras. Entregamos uma solução completa aos restaurantes do Ponto de Venda à Retaguarda. Demais, né?

E como se não bastasse, recentemente o Ifood também virou nosso investidor, o que significa que vamos acelerar muito nosso crescimento nos próximos meses, e precisamos de alguém para agregar ao time de produto e nos ajudar a fazer a diferença. Você será responsável pelo desenvolvimento e evolução de produtos que apoiam os restaurantes nas suas operações de atendimento presencial e delivery. É um desafio com alto impacto direto no dia a dia do restaurante, e o objetivo é ajudar os restaurantes a simplificar e agilizar sua operação.

E ai, topa esse desafio?

As responsabilidades neste papel são:

  • Capacidade de conectar estratégia de negócio à criação de soluções que geram valor para o cliente final e resultados para a empresa.
  • Definir, priorizar e comunicar os objetivos do produto, compreendendo tendências de mercado e necessidades dos clientes para identificar novas oportunidades;
  • Garantir a execução do roadmap com foco em entrega contínua de valor;
  • Realizar pesquisas, análises de dados e entrevistas para entender a fundo as partes interessadas no produto, buscando entender as dores dos clientes e realizando experimentações para encontrar as melhores soluções (Product Discovery);
  • Acompanhar tendências de mercado para identificar novas oportunidades para o negócio.
  • Trabalhar com times de engenharia e design para especificar, priorizar e acompanhar a evolução do produto, garantindo entregas constantes de valor.
  • Acompanhar KPIs e Métricas de iniciativas de produto para garantir o atingimento de resultados esperados pelo negócio.
  • Atuar com o lançamento de novas funcionalidades e produtos, garantindo que os times internos e os clientes estejam preparados para adotar e extrair valor das soluções.

Se você se reconhece nessas características e se identifica com o escopo, confere os requisitos:

  • Experiência com concepção e evolução de produtos digitais.
  • Experiência com produtos voltados ao consumidor final (B2C).
  • Experiência com definição e acompanhamento de métricas de produto orientadas a resultado (como adoção, engajamento, ativação ou retenção).
  • Vivência em processos de product discovery e entrega contínua.
  • Capacidade analítica e orientada a dados para tomada de decisão.
  • Habilidades de comunicação, organização e colaboração com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e capacidade de operar em ciclos curtos com entrega de valor contínua.
  • Formação superior completa em áreas relacionadas.
  • 5+ anos de experiência com produtos digitais.

Desejável, mas não obrigatório:

  • Experiência anterior com ferramentas de CRM, Cardápios Digitais para Food Service ou marketing automation.
  • Experiência em produtos voltados para o setor de food service.
  • Conhecimento sobre frameworks como Shape Up, OKRs, Jobs To Be Done ou similares.
  • Habilidades com ferramentas de métricas de utilização de produtos, como Google Analytics, Pendo, Mixpanel ou Amplitude.

description:
