Overview

Join to apply for the Experienced Recruiter For The Swedish IT Industry role at Nexer Telescope.

Sweden needs skilled engineers! About 30 000 of them by 2030 to be precise, according to the Swedish Statistical Central Bureau. Right now we have ~200 open positions for Software Engineers with our clients in Sweden. Are you ready to help us?

Job Description

As a senior headhunter you will help us to find engineers who are ready to embark on an adventure to Sweden. Living standards in Sweden are great by any international comparisons, and we need a lot of engineers. Your job will be to find them and inform them about all the benefits of living and working in Sweden. To move to another country is often one of the biggest leaps in life, so a lot of your job will be to build trust with suitable candidates. Supporting you in these tasks, you will have the assistance of a competent global team of recruiters, as well as an executive management team in Sweden. In addition you will be supported by our Swedish delivery management team that handles all practical matters related to the relocation to Sweden for our consultants. In short we fix everything for our employees - visa, work permits, tickets, arrangement of housing, you name it - we fix it! Our clients are primarily within the fields of software development, R&D, cyber security, automotive, embedded systems, telecommunications, online solutions and application development. Your work will be planned and executed together with your colleagues in Albania, Argentina, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Brazil, Colombia, Hungary, Kenya, North Macedonia, Sweden, Turkey, Ukraine, Venezuela and Vietnam. You will be part of an efficient team characterized by a profound joy for having the opportunity to be able to help engineers and their families to build a new career and life in Sweden. Telescope's core values are joy, trust, and professionalism.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and engage engineers with the potential to relocate to Sweden.
  • Communicate the benefits of living and working in Sweden and build trust with candidates.
  • Coordinate with a global recruitment team and Swedish management to support relocation logistics.
  • Manage the end-to-end recruitment process for IT engineers and ensure a smooth relocation experience.

Qualifications

  • At least 5 years of professional experience from recruitment in the IT sector, or similar technical experience.
  • Solid and well-proven network of local engineering talent within IT.
  • Extremely service oriented, with a flexible mindset towards finding the best solution.
  • High quality and brand awareness.
  • Understanding or interest in headhunting and IT outstaffing/outsourcing.
  • Upper intermediate English.
  • Knowledge of contemporary IT technologies and ability to learn new technologies.
  • Analytical, well organized with attention to detail, able to identify and close recruitment requests.
  • Self-confident, social, outgoing with self-motivation.
  • Resilient, able to handle rejection and stay motivated.
  • Passionate about success with a professional but relaxed attitude toward work, colleagues, and customers.
  • Responsive and responsible, with a presentable appearance.

Details

  • Extent & Duration: Start ASAP. Full-time. Long-term contract as a Private Entrepreneur. Minimum 12 months. Eight hours of efficient work per day, Monday to Friday. Overtime compensation 1:1 in flex.
  • Location: Remote or from a co-location center of your choice.
  • Remuneration: Starting at 1200 USD, plus remittance fees and taxes. Free national holidays with maintained payment. 20 paid vacation days. Paid travels, housing, and per diem.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Overview

About Firstbase Tens of thousands of businesses — from newly incorporated startups to public enterprises — rely on Firstbase to streamline compliance, finance, analytics, and every part of the back office. It is one platform to run your entire company. Our goal is to make running a business feel like magic. We own the general ledger and unify data across all business functions. Compliance tasks are flagged — and often resolved — automatically. Real-time business metrics are accurate, accessible, and easy to understand. And if you need to hire a new employee, send an invoice, or file taxes, you can do it from the same interface.

How We Work We cherish the moments when noise fades and we move with clarity, confidence, and focus — doing the right thing at the right time. These moments are when our best work happens, and we strive to create more of them. We value craftsmanship over busyness, clarity over complexity, and resilience above all — whether it takes hard work or patience. We aim high, avoid mediocrity, and speak with fearless transparency. We believe in upward mobility and take pride in growing talent from within, always preferring to promote our own before looking externally.

About The Team We’re a small, nimble, and ambitious product team that thrives on collaboration, creativity, and impact. We value engineers who care deeply about clean code, strong architecture, and delivering an exceptional user experience to a global community of founders. From writing and reviewing code to shaping key product decisions, we’re building software that’s fast, scalable, and beautifully simple. Our product is built using PHP, Golang, Node.js, Vue, MySQL, PostgreSQL, AWS. We also use Redis, Vue Router, Vuex, Docker Compose, Docker, GitLab CI, and Graylog, and some third-party APIs like Stripe. We use Slack, Clubhouse, Notion, Whimsical, Figma, and G Suite to collaborate and build together.

What You Will Do

Step into one of the most pivotal engineering roles at Firstbase — where you’ll scale a high-growth org, lead mission-critical architecture, and shape the future of our platform through world-class execution, innovation, and technical excellence.

Your Responsibilities

  • Develop high-quality software design and architecture using Vue, PHP, and Golang
  • Identify, prioritize, and execute tasks throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Build tools and applications by writing clean, efficient, and maintainable code
  • Write, test, and review code in a collaborative environment
  • Collaborate with internal teams and vendors to improve our products
  • Partner with product and design to define, shape, and plan deliverables
  • Make sound technical decisions following best practices and engineering standards
  • Identify and resolve issues that may affect product quality or business outcomes

Requirements

Location : Based in a LATAM country (this is a fully remote position)

  • Technical Experience : 5+ years of experience with PHP in production environments
  • 2+ years of experience with Golang is a plus
  • Experience with PHP frameworks such as Symfony or Laravel
  • Experience with Vue, PostgreSQL, AWS, Redis, Docker Compose, GitLab CI, Stripe , and/or Datadog
  • Startup Background : 2+ years in a similar role at a high-growth startup
  • Leadership experience
  • Autonomy & Leadership :
    • Ability to lead engineering efforts independently
    • Comfortable being the sole engineer in cross-functional initiatives
  • Work Ethic & Mindset :
    • Self-starter — able to identify problems and propose/execute solutions without heavy direction
    • Proactive ownership — consistently seeks out impactful work and drives it to completion
  • Cross-functional Collaboration : Experience working with non-technical teams such as product, marketing, and design
  • Communication : Strong English communication skills , both written and verbal
  • Architecture & Delivery : Proven ability to deliver well-architected, scalable solutions

Perks & benefits

  • Competitive salary & equity: We pay top-tier because you deserve it — plus generous equity package so you can share in the success of the future we’re building together.
  • Generous raises & stock refreshers: Your impact deserves recognition. We review compensation quite frequently to ensure you're rewarded as your role grows — including stock refreshers so you continue to share in the upside of what we’re building together.
  • Flexible work setup: We offer the freedom to work remotely, embracing diverse work styles, while NYC-based team members can opt for a hybrid setup, spending some days in the office to foster collaboration.
  • Unlimited PTO & other time off benefits: Take the opportunity to rest and recharge. No questions asked — it’s time to disconnect and come back stronger. Plus, paid sick days, your birthday off, and national holidays.
  • Success stipend: We provide a renewable stipend on day one and every two years to create your perfect work setup — laptops, headphones, and more. It’s about giving you the tools to do your best work.
  • Comprehensive health benefits: Comprehensive health insurance reimbursement arrangement. No matter where you are, you’re covered.
  • Learning & development: We invest in your growth. Firstbase will pay for courses, events, and anything that helps you become better in your craft.
  • Annual anniversary gift: Receive a special gift each year to celebrate your journey with Firstbase as a thank you for your dedication.
  • Parental Leave: We support you through life’s big moments — maternity, paternity, or adoption — with fully paid time off.
  • Generous annual bonuses that grow: Expect a bonus that reflects your hard work — usually about 10% of your base salary in the first year. From your second year, a 20% annual multiplier boosts this, rewarding your consistent performance.
  • Company Gatherings: We host annual retreats, quarterly in-person leadership planning, and occasional co-working days and happy hours — all fully covered to help us connect and have fun in person.
  • Vacation bonus: After 3 years at Firstbase, you'll receive a generous vacation bonus to take that dream trip. It’s our way of saying "thank you" for your commitment — we’re here for the long haul, and we want you to enjoy the ride.
  • Visa sponsorship: We support the best talent — wherever you are from. Firstbase offers visa sponsorship and renewal assistance if you are already in the US, or are looking to move to join our NYC-based team.
  • Business travel & collaboration budget: Great work happens together. We cover team travel expenses so you can connect in person — whether it’s a strategy sprint, team meetup, or just time to build stronger relationships.
  • Upward mobility: We grow from within. When new roles open up, we look to our own team first — because we believe in recognizing potential, rewarding performance, and giving our people the opportunity to level up.

Interested? Even if you don’t check every single box but you’re passionate about the role and want to help build something great, we still want to hear from you. We value diverse experiences and unique perspectives. Want to work at Firstbase but don’t see an opening that fits your experience? Email us at — we will often “create” a role around a great candidate.

Overview

The Brazil Channel Account Manager role is a key function and the central hub around which all partner productivity and value is created. This role requires an entrepreneurial spirit, willingness to work hard, and the ability to creatively problem solve with a strong sense of outcome ownership. The candidate must communicate clearly across marketing, operations, finance, accounting, and sales within Datalogic and with identified partners to express the vision for their business and outline specific needs to work toward that vision. Location is remote from Brazil with the ability to travel extensively (50%+ of the time) across the region.

Role Mission

To be successful, identify key partners in the market and develop a shared 3–5-year strategy with each to grow their business with Datalogic in a consistent and predictive way.

Responsibilities

  • Engage with channel partners to drive productivity and value creation for the business.
  • Communicate the vision and partner needs across marketing, operations, finance, accounting, and sales within Datalogic and with partners.
  • Develop and implement a shared long-term strategy (3–5 years) with key partners.
  • Travel extensively across the region (50%+).

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree (BA/BS) in business, economics, marketing, or related field.
  • Fluent English; written and verbal communication skills.
  • At least 5 years of experience managing distribution partners, including business plan development, contract execution, and partner relationship management.
  • Deep understanding of channel and distribution models with strong analytical and strategic planning skills.
  • Proven experience in developing and executing business plans.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and organizational abilities.
  • Experience in bar code scanning, mobile computing, wireless technology (Wifi, WLAN, Bluetooth) preferred.
  • Negotiation and presentation skills; ability to present to multi-level clients.
  • Willingness and ability to travel extensively (50%+ of the time) across the region.

Other Information And Skills

  • Results orientation: drive to achieve short- and long-term goals.
  • Customer focus: identify and meet customer needs (internal or external).
  • Interpersonal characteristics: open, communicative, collaborative, trustworthy, and able to handle constructive conflict.
  • Motivational characteristics: high energy, competitive drive, autonomy, and ability to work with less structure.
  • Sense of urgency: proactive problem identification and action.

Company Background

Datalogic is a global technology leader in automatic data capture and factory automation, specializing in barcode readers, mobile computers, sensors, RFID, vision, and laser marking systems. title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
Overview

Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Xometry is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science team. This person will drive data science initiatives, provide technical guidance when needed, and leverage data to solve complex business challenges. The ideal candidate has a deep understanding of data science methodologies, strong statistical expertise, and proven experience delivering impactful data solutions in a dynamic environment. This is a 1-year contract with the potential for extension.

Responsibilities

  • Use data analysis, visualization, and modeling tools (e.g., Looker, Jupyter Notebooks, Python, Pandas) to drive data-driven business strategies, with a focus on cost prediction for a two-sided marketplace.
  • Design and execute data science projects, including hypothesis development, statistical analysis, and experimentation (e.g., A/B testing) to answer key business questions and validate assumptions.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate business needs into data science solutions and ensure alignment with Xometry’s objectives.
  • Analyze existing algorithms for accuracy and performance, provide recommendations for optimization, and update production code as necessary.
  • Query and extract data from databases (e.g., Snowflake, MongoDB) to support analysis and model development.
  • Implement robust data science methodologies, emphasizing best practices in code reproducibility, version control, and model deployment.
  • Continuously iterate and improve solutions within a fast-paced, agile environment, addressing challenges with innovative, data-driven approaches.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, teamwork, and continuous learning, encouraging knowledge sharing and skill development within the team.

Qualifications

  • A bachelor’s degree is required; an advanced degree (M.S. or PhD) in applied math, computer science, data science, engineering, or a related field is highly preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in data science
  • Strong expertise in SQL and Python (numpy, scipy, pandas, and scikit-learn preferred) and experience with API integrations using Python.
  • Proficient in applied statistics, including knowledge of probability distributions, confidence intervals, statistical tests (e.g., t-tests, ANOVA, Chi-Square), and power analysis.
  • Experience with pricing algorithms and technology-driven product development.
  • Knowledge of scientific software principles, including version control, code reproducibility, and deployment practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and manage shifting priorities effectively.
  • Must be able to work core hours aligned with US Eastern Time (GMT-5).
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with global teams and articulate complex technical information to non-technical stakeholders.

Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status.

For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.

Overview

Who we are

At Artefact Brasil, we believe in and live a culture based on empathy! A healthy work environment is a place where all voices are heard, respected, and valued. We are committed to building a more diverse and inclusive environment, because empathy is for everyone, regardless of ethnicity, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or religious belief. What you will be doing:

Responsibilities

  • Develop and refine complex data features from large-scale datasets to improve model accuracy and business performance.
  • Champion data quality and integrity , defining the requirements for robust datasets needed for advanced analytics and modeling.
  • Monitor, analyze, and troubleshoot the performance of deployed models, addressing issues like concept drift, data quality degradation, and performance bottlenecks.
  • Provide technical leadership in the application of statistical modeling, machine learning, and advanced analytics to solve complex business problems.
  • Document and present complex methodologies, model findings, and strategic recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Lead by example, championing a culture of scientific rigor, experimentation, and continuous learning within the data science team.
  • Mentor and coach junior data scientists and analysts, fostering their growth through code reviews, design discussions, and knowledge sharing.

What we are looking for:

A degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Engineering, Economics, or a related quantitative field.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate across multiple teams and levels of the organization.
  • Demonstrated ability to balance hands-on technical delivery with mentoring and team enablement.
  • Excellent problem-solving skills , with the ability to troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Curiosity: You are passionate about finding innovative solutions to complex problems. You seek to understand the entire value chain and how your ML models integrate with front-end applications, back-end systems, and the underlying data infrastructure to deliver business value.
  • Collaboration: Knowledge sharing is essential to you, and you actively contribute to spreading information within Artefact.
  • Entrepreneurship: You bring solutions, new ideas, and innovations.
  • Fluent English: You are comfortable communicating in English, as it is essential for working in our international environment.

Required Technical Experience

You have practical experience with several tools and technologies in the modern data stack, such as:

  • Programming Languages: Strong skills in Python for data science (pandas, numpy, scikitlearn, pyspark); Nice to Have experience with a deep learning framework like PyTorch or TensorFlow/Keras
  • Cloud Data Platforms: Hands-on with at least one of Google Cloud Platform (GCP), AWS, Azure, Databricks
  • Data Warehousing & Databases: Familiar with tools such as PostgreSQL, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake
  • Machine Learning models: Experience with supervised learning models (xgboost, logistic regression, etc), unsupervised learning models (clustering algorithms)
  • MLOPS: Experience with at least one: Databricks, mlflow, AWS Sagemaker, Vertex AI; Git code versioning workflow and platforms (Github, Azure Devops, Gitlab etc)

What we offer

  • Free Office – work from home or anywhere you want!
  • Gympass – access to gyms and wellness programs
  • Insurance – life, health, and dental coverage
  • In-person Meetings 3x a Year – our famous “Get Together” with workshops, talks, trainings, and happy hour!
  • Woba – book a coworking space wherever you like!
  • Semiannual Reviews – with opportunities for promotion

Why you should join us

  • Artefact is the place to be: come and build the future of the data field
  • Progress: every day offers new challenges and new learning opportunities
  • Culture: Empathy and Collaboration are in our DNA
  • Entrepreneurship: you will join a team of motivated entrepreneurs. We won\'t give up until we make a big difference in this industry!

A Verity está buscando novos talentos!

Somos uma aceleradora de soluções digitais e buscamosArquiteto de Soluções para fazer parte dessa jornada.

Olha só quais são as experiências e conhecimentos que você precisa ter para acelerar e transformar com a gente:


Main responsibilities

Compreensão e Análise de Negócio:

  • Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio.
  • Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor.
  • Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.).
  • Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um.
  • Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas.

Arquitetura e Design da Solução:

  • Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos.
  • Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade.
  • Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade).
  • Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência).
  • Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade.
  • Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc).
  • Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades.
  • Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança).
  • Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc).
  • Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas.
  • Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras.
  • Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.).
  • Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta.

Documentação e Apresentação:

  • Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa.
  • Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados.
  • Centralizar documentações (Readme).
  • Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução.
  • Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo.
  • Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento.

Implementação e Operação:

  • Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução.
  • Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente.
  • Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas.

Requisitos Diferenciais:

  • Definir os passos para migrar de um sistema de transição para a nova arquitetura (Arquitetura de Transição).
  • Considerar os riscos e desafios da migração.
  • Mapear os principais Riscos e Desafios identificados durante a proposta da solução.
  • Descrever ações mitigatórias para os Riscos e possíveis soluções para os Desafios mapeados.
  • Demonstrar conhecimento sobre as vantagens e desvantagens das tecnologias escolhidas.
  • Demonstrar consciência dos tradeoffs envolvidos em cada decisão de arquitetura.

Requirements and skills

Experiência:

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de arquitetura de soluções, com foco em integração de sistemas e otimização de processos.
  • Experiência em análise de requisitos de negócios (funcionais e não funcionais) e transformação em soluções técnicas.
  • Experiência com a definição e implementação de padrões arquiteturais (microsserviços, filas de mensagens, etc.).
  • Vivência em ambientes de desenvolvimento ágil.

Conhecimentos Técnicos:

  • Profundo conhecimento de padrões de integração de sistemas (APIs, mensageria, etc.).
  • Sólido conhecimento de arquiteturas orientadas a microsserviços.
  • Familiaridade com diferentes tecnologias e plataformas de desenvolvimento (ex: Java, .NET, Python, Node.js , Cloud, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de modelagem (ex: UML).
  • Conhecimento de segurança da informação (autenticação, autorização, criptografia).
  • Conhecimento de monitoramento e observabilidade de sistemas.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento de código (ex: Git).
  • Conhecimento de estimativa de custos de infraestrutura e licenças.

Habilidades:

  • Excelente capacidade de comunicação e negociação para influenciar stakeholders técnicos e de negócio.
  • Visão sistêmica e capacidade de análise crítica para identificar oportunidades de melhoria em processos e sistemas.
  • Habilidade de traduzir requisitos de negócios em especificações técnicas claras e concisas.
  • Capacidade de tomar decisões técnicas embasadas em dados e em um profundo entendimento dos trade-offs envolvidos.
  • Habilidade de documentar soluções de forma clara e organizada.
  • Capacidade de liderar tecnicamente equipes de desenvolvimento.

Remote

The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify’s text-to-speech products to turn whatever they’re reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify’s text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its App of the Day.

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office.   • Experience with public cloud environments, GCP preferred

Competencies

  • Experience in supply chain optimization, cost management, and change management
  • Exceptional project and program management skills

Job description

Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ️

Adnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, adnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes.

O Operador de Equipamentos ficará responsável por realizar a operação de atendimento de rampa (movimentação de equipamentos motorizados ou não, embarque e desembarque de passageiros cadeirantes, transporte de bagagens e cargas entre as áreas operacionais do aeroporto) em aeronaves com segurança, qualidade e pontualidade, garantindo eficiência no processo e colaborando para a construção da percepção do cliente quanto aos serviços prestados pela empresa no que tange ao transporte de bagagens, cargas e pontualidade dos voos.

Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para oAeroporto de Salvador (SSA)!


Main responsibilities

  • Operar os equipamentos de rampa, realizando a movimentação segura de equipamentos rebocáveis no que tange a logística de preparação de box para atendimento dos voos com equipamentos necessários de acordo com a disponibilidade, levando-se em consideração o load fator, turnaroud da aeronave, distribuição de cargas e bagagens nos porões;
  • Disponibilizar os equipamentos de GPU, ACU e LPU sempre que a aeronave estiver com APU inoperante e/ou para a execução do projeto smart fuel;
  • Realizar o transporte de bagagem e cargas entre variadas áreas de cada aeroporto que estão embarcando, desembarcando ou em conexão;
  • Garantir a segurança de todos durante o atendimento operacional;
  • Garantir a transferência das bagagens de conexão imediata (HOT), para as outas aeronaves;
  • Recolher os equipamentos do box após o termino do atendimento.

Requirements and skills

  • Carteira Nacional de Habilitação (CNH) tipo D/E .
  • Visão analítica e sistemática, para tomadas de decisões;
  • Disponibilidade de horário;
  • Conhecimento em processo de atendimento ao cliente;

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para desenvolvimento das tarefas.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para condução dos veículos (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

description:
Selecione a frequência (em dias) para receber um alerta:

Localização: Salvador, BR

O Inspired é o maior grupo internacional de educação básica premium, com um portfólio de 119 escolas espalhadas pelos 6 continentes e que utilizam as melhores práticas educacionais de cada canto do mundo, garantindo uma experiência de aprendizado de qualidade máxima para mais de 90.000 alunos do Infantil ao Ensino Médio.

Nossas escolas Inspired estão em 27 países e cada uma é pensada individualmente de acordo com o contexto local e é ancorada na cultura vibrante na qual se encontra. Coletivamente, elas compõem uma comunidade que nutre o desenvolvimento acadêmico e pessoal dos alunos num ambiente de aprendizagem progressivo, dinâmico e inovador.

Se juntando ao nosso time de mais de 13.000 colaboradores, você poderá trabalhar em instalações de última geração ao lado de educadores e líderes renomados do setor em alguns dos lugares mais desejados do mundo. Investimos fortemente nas nossas equipes e assim cada um consegue aproveitar desenvolvimento profissional, oportunidades de carreira excepcionais e mobilidade em todo o nosso grupo.

A Gurilândia e a Land School são escolas Inspired no Brasil. O amor e o acolhimento são marcas da escola, semeadas pela Tia Vera desde a sua fundação e a Gurilândia e a Land School se baseiam em quatro pilares - Tradição, Inovação, Excelência Acadêmica e Mentalidade Internacional. Há 60 anos estamos educando gerações em Salvador, e preparando os nossos alunos para os desafios de hoje com uma educação que alia vanguarda e tradição.

Neste papel, você será responsável por promover o bem-estar emocional e psicológico dos alunos, apoiar o processo de aprendizagem, identificar e tratar questões emocionais ou comportamentais, e contribuir para a construção de um ambiente escolar inclusivo e saudável.

O que você fará:

  • Orientação a Pais e Educadores : Orientar pais, professores e outros membros da comunidade escolar sobre como lidar com questões comportamentais ou emocionais dos alunos. Oferecer estratégias de apoio para o desenvolvimento saudável das crianças e adolescentes;
  • Promoção de Saúde Mental : Desenvolver e implementar programas de prevenção e promoção da saúde mental, trabalhando na conscientização sobre questões como bullying, depressão, ansiedade, abuso de substâncias e outros temas relevantes;
  • Aconselhamento Escolar : Apoiar professores e gestores educacionais em questões relacionadas ao comportamento dos alunos, sugerindo intervenções pedagógicas ou adaptativas quando necessário;
  • Mediar Conflitos : Atuar na mediação de conflitos entre alunos, professores e/ou pais, buscando soluções para melhorar a convivência escolar e fortalecer o respeito mútuo;
  • Apoio a Projetos Educativos : Colaborar com a escola na implementação de projetos e atividades voltados para o desenvolvimento emocional e social dos alunos;
  • Acompanhamento de Casos Especiais : Trabalhar em parceria com outros profissionais (como assistentes sociais, psiquiatras e terapeutas) no acompanhamento de alunos com necessidades especiais ou transtornos mais graves;
  • Educação Socioemocional : Realizar atividades educativas sobre habilidades socioemocionais, como empatia, resolução de conflitos, habilidades de comunicação e autoestima.

DENTRO DO CONTEXTO DA DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA: Por mais que nos esforcemos para incluir todas as principais responsabilidades e atribuições desta posição, pode ser que nem toda atividade pertinente à função tenha sido identificada. Dessa forma, a lista acima não é restritiva e pode ser estendida ou alterada para incluir outras tarefas que se aplicam ao cargo.

O que você precisa ter:

  • Graduação em Psicologia;
  • Empatia e sensibilidade às necessidades dos alunos;
  • Conhecimento sobre desenvolvimento infantil e adolescente, bem como das dinâmicas escolares.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:

  • Experiência em escolas bilíngues ou internacionais;
  • Inglês avançado ou fluente.

DECLARAÇÃO DE SALVAGUARDA

O Inspired se compromete em salvaguardar e promover o bem-estar das crianças e jovens e, se você se juntar ao nosso time, esperaremos o mesmo de você, assim como que se comprometa a realizar os treinamentos de safeguarding que consideramos pertinentes à sua função. A proteção do bem-estar dos nossos alunos é de responsabilidade de todos os colaboradores e os mesmos devem se comportar de maneira a refletir os princípios e valores da organização. Qualquer candidato pode ser submetido aos procedimentos apropriados de verificação.

AMZ Advisers Amazon Account Manager Job Description

About AMZ Advisers: AMZ Advisers is a digital media marketing agency focused on developing and implementing strategic marketing plans for the global Amazon marketplaces. Our Account Management team is organized into pods, consisting of Senior Account Managers (SAMs), Junior Account Managers (JAMs), and Apprentices and Interns. As a Senior Account Manager, you will provide guidance, mentorship, and strategic oversight for other Account Managers in your pod by contributing to the development of training programs, while ensuring the success of your pod’s client portfolio. You will embrace the challenge of managing your own client portfolio, leading your team, and strategic planning.

What You’ll Do

  • General Responsibilities

  • Maintain a portfolio that will gradually grow to 10 clients and aim to hold a high retention rate.

  • Build long-lasting client relationships by clearly and concisely managing expectations.

  • Build and track KPIs for all accounts under personal client portfolio management.

  • Participate in daily stand-up meetings to raise problems or blockers for timely resolution to keep tasks on track.

Team Structure & Development

  • Team Assignment: Assign team members to clients based on skills, expertise, and client portfolios.

  • Ensure a balanced mix of experience levels for each team member to facilitate knowledge sharing.

  • Training & Onboarding: Develop comprehensive training programs for Junior Account Managers, focusing on industry knowledge, account management best practices, and company processes. Mentor and guide junior team members in collaboration with Strategists.

  • Integrate Strategists: Conduct client account audits and develop tailored client strategies; collaborate with the team to implement effective strategies.

  • Pod Collaboration: Foster regular collaboration within pods through meetings, brainstorming, and strategy discussions; facilitate communication and document sharing.

  • Check-ins & Accountability: Conduct regular check-ins with teams to assess client progress, address issues, and identify new strategies; determine upsell opportunities and encourage proactive problem solving.

  • Client Communication & Feedback: Emphasize proactive and transparent client communication; encourage client feedback and ensure swift conflict resolution.

How We’ll Measure Success

  • Retention Rate: Percentage of retained clients month over month.

  • Blocker/Conflict Resolution Time: Time to resolve client issues or blockers.

  • Client Communication: Quality and frequency of client interactions.

  • Strategy Effectiveness: Success of client strategies considering feedback and performance metrics.

  • Pod Follow Ups: Regular follow ups to assess client performance.

description:
Overview

Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we are helping usher in the promise of AI. Innodata offers a powerful combination of both digital data solutions and easy-to-use, high-quality platforms. Our global workforce includes over 5,000 employees in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, the Philippines, India, Sri Lanka, Israel and Germany.

Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

About The Role

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with (Master's or PhD) in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will play a critical role in shaping how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a specific focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within the field of medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host–pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model's reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master's or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
  • As part of the project, you are required to complete the English language assessment. The assessment is mandatory & non-billable.

description:
Overview

Company Description

Miratech helps visionaries change the world. We are a global IT services and consulting company that brings together enterprise and start-up innovation. Today, we support digital transformation for some of the world's largest enterprises. By partnering with both large and small players, we stay at the leading edge of technology, remain nimble even as a global leader, and create technology that helps our clients further enhance their business. We are a values-driven organization and our culture of Relentless Performance has enabled over 99% of Miratech's engagements to succeed by meeting or exceeding our scope, schedule, and/or budget objectives since our inception in 1989. Miratech has coverage across 5 continents and operates in over 25 countries around the world. Miratech retains nearly 1000 full-time professionals, and our annual growth rate exceeds 25%.

Job Description

Looking for an exciting opportunity to grow and make an impact with a high-performing global team? The Senior Recruiter role at Miratech could be your next big move. We're looking for someone experienced in sourcing and engaging administrative talent across the globe, with a passion for creating exceptional recruiting experiences. You’ll help internal stakeholders attract the best talent while focusing on creative sourcing, deep research, and global market insights. If you're a well-connected, curious individual with a passion for non-tech recruiting, this role is for you. You’ll lead recruitment efforts for administrative and executive talent, driving every stage of the hiring process—from developing sourcing strategies to negotiating offers. Building strong networks inside and outside the company is key. By leveraging market insights, you’ll create search strategies that find and engage top administrative talent, helping us meet our customers’ needs. Ready to make a difference? Join us at Miratech and be part of something exciting!

Responsibilities

  • Lead the full cycle hiring process for global roles, with a strong focus on critical and difficult-to-fill external searches with a focus on enterprise software/technical engineering positions
  • Develop innovative sourcing strategies, leveraging global market research and talent intelligence to attract top-tier candidates.
  • Partner closely with hiring managers, operations lead, and senior leadership to align hiring needs with business objectives.
  • Create a positive and engaging recruitment journey, ensuring smooth communication and a seamless interview process for candidates.
  • Drive inclusive hiring strategies to build a diverse workforce, especially within contact center.
  • Continuously improve hiring workflows, implement best practices, and leverage recruitment technologies for efficiency.
  • Utilize hiring metrics and recruitment analytics to enhance hiring strategies, forecast talent needs, and drive continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • 4+ experience in end-to-end hiring, with a strong track record in IT and contact center recruitment across global markets.
  • Ability to partner effectively with hiring managers, operational leaders, and executives, aligning hiring strategies with business goals.
  • Proficiency in passive talent sourcing, market mapping, and competitor intelligence to attract top-tier candidates.
  • Strong analytical skills to track hiring metrics, optimize recruitment strategies, and improve time-to-hire efficiency.
  • Experience managing niche hiring across multiple geographies while driving Diversity & Inclusion initiatives.
  • Ability to engage, influence, and negotiate with candidates and stakeholders, ensuring smooth recruitment processes and positive candidate experience.
  • Experience hiring for contact center technologies like Genesys, Avaya, NICE, Five9, and other cloud-based and on-premises solutions.

Benefits

  • We offer: Culture of Relentless Performance: join an unstoppable technology development team with a 99% project success rate and more than 30% year-over-year revenue growth.
  • Competitive Pay and Benefits: enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, and a relocation program.
  • Work From Anywhere Culture: make the most of the flexibility that comes with remote work.
  • Growth Mindset: reap the benefits of a range of professional development opportunities, including certification programs, mentorship and talent investment programs, internal mobility and internship opportunities.
  • Global Impact: collaborate on impactful projects for top global clients and shape the future of industries.
  • Welcoming Multicultural Environment: be a part of a dynamic, global team and thrive in an inclusive and supportive work environment with open communication and regular team-building company social events.
  • Social Sustainability Values: join our sustainable business practices focused on five pillars, including IT education, community empowerment, fair operating practices, environmental sustainability, and gender equality.

Overview

Sobre a Allintra

A Allintra é uma startup brasileira de tecnologia com uma missão ambiciosa: transformar a forma como o trading de criptoativos é feito no Brasil. Estamos construindo uma plataforma de investimento de nível profissional, inteligente e colaborativa conectando traders experientes a investidores em um ecossistema seguro, transparente e poderoso. Estamos no momento mais decisivo da nossa jornada: o lançamento do Beta Test privado da plataforma. E para garantir que essa fase seja inesquecível para nossos primeiros 500 usuários, buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por experiência do cliente, tecnologia e construção de comunidade.

Sua missão

Você será a ponte entre nossos usuários e o time Allintra. Vai garantir que os traders se sintam ouvidos, valorizados e empoderados, transformando seus feedbacks em decisões estratégicas de produto. Durante o lançamento, será responsável por cultivar uma comunidade ativa, acompanhar a jornada dos primeiros usuários e traduzir suas experiências em insights acionáveis. Você irá atuar diretamente na construção da jornada dos usuários reais, desenvolvendo processos de engajamento, estruturando canais de escuta e ajudando a consolidar uma cultura de produto centrada no cliente. Mais do que suporte, buscamos o protagonista na criação de experiências que encantem, envolvem e gerem valor real.

Responsabilidades

  • Atuar na estruturação da experiência contínua dos usuários da plataforma, garantindo um atendimento encantador e proativo.
  • Ser o ponto focal de relacionamento com os usuários e clientes do Allintra, garantindo engajamento, acolhimento e suporte proativo.
  • Manter a escuta ativa da comunidade de usuários, identificando comportamentos, desafios e oportunidades de evolução de produto.
  • Acompanhar a jornada de uso e mapear pontos de atrito ou oportunidades de encantamento dos usuários.
  • Coletar feedbacks via formulários, entrevistas e 1:1s com usuários, transformando as percepções em relatórios estruturados e acionáveis para as áreas de Produto e Marketing.
  • Conduzir réguas de comunicação (convites, atualizações, avisos de melhorias), reforçando o vínculo dos usuários com a evolução da plataforma.
  • Desenvolver processos de CX escaláveis, desde fluxos de boas-vindas até estratégias de encantamento, retenção e ativação de usuários reais.
  • Apoiar a implementação de métricas de experiência (NPS, CSAT, churn reasons) e propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks reais.
  • Participar da construção de estratégias de fidelização contínua dos clientes, sempre colocando a experiência no centro das decisões.
  • Identificar usuários influentes para transformá-los em promotores da marca os primeiros Allintra Pioneers.

O que buscamos

  • Experiência comprovada em Customer Experience, Customer Success ou Relacionamento com clientes B2C;
  • Excelente capacidade em Comunicação e Escuta com usuários (Traders e Investidores);
  • Curiosidade, resiliência e agilidade para entender a fundo as dores dos usuários e estruturar feedbacks com lógica;
  • Experiência anterior com ferramentas de CRM (RD Station CRM, Zendesk, Hubspot, etc);
  • Capacidade de coletar, interpretar e usar dados de feedback para tomar decisões informadas

Overview

Medical Writer - Senior Regulatory Writing Specialist
Location: Remote

Position Summary

The Senior Regulatory Writing Specialist is a professional responsible for the creation of regulatory materials for investigational and marketed products in alignment with regulatory and compliance practices. The individual will work directly with client teams to manage regulatory writing projects.

Essential Functions

  • Regulatory writing skills with mastery of 3 or more regulatory document types (eg, clinical study protocols, clinical study reports, briefing documents, IND, NDA, and MAA components).
  • Solid understanding of and ability to apply the statistical, regulatory, and medical communication concepts needed to independently write regulatory documents in more than 1 therapeutic area. Manages at least 3 single-document projects simultaneously.
  • Working knowledge of relevant regulatory guidance (eg, ICH, FDA, EMA) for clinical trial conduct, including document-specific guidance. Core cross-functional clinical research roles and procedures, and how they relate to document preparation. Acts as a primary writer and/or project manager for key documents and projects.
  • Ensures document accuracy, completeness, and consistency of messaging. Organizes and leads cross-functional document review meetings, clarifies and incorporates feedback, and works with cross-functional subject matter experts to resolve unclear comments and differences of opinion between functional areas.
  • Performs document-level QC (including abbreviations, references to sources, data in text versus data in tables, figures, or graphs) and writer peer review (logical flow, sense check, etc.).
  • Leads project-level management activities, i.e., timeline preparation and oversight and meeting scheduling. Participates in guiding less experienced writers on those documents for which they have expertise.
  • Proactively contributes to improvements to medical writing processes.
  • Understands, complies with, and contributes to the updates of SOPs, templates, best practices, policies, and regulatory writing style guides.
  • Develops project-level lexicons and conventions.

Position Qualifications

Above average attention to detail, teamwork and initiative. Ability to interact with other departments within the company and be proficient in written and verbal communication. Proficient in Microsoft Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook, and quickly able to learn new software. Ability to apply regulatory guidelines to content development.

Skills and Abilities

Education: Advanced degree in a scientific discipline (e.g., life sciences, pharmacy, medicine) or relevant work experience; or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience.

Experience: More than 2 years (typically 3-5 years) of experience in scientific/medical/regulatory writing in the pharmaceutical domain.

Computer Skills: Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.

Work Environment

Remote - Europe

title: YouTube Manager
description:
A Impact Media is on a mission to empower real estate professionals to own their market through media.

At A Impact Media, we hire for impact. If you’re exceptional at what you do and align with our core values—Beyond Excellence, Extreme Ownership, Proactive Curiosity, and Mission Focused—we want to know you.

Role

We are hiring a YouTube Manager for A Impact Media. The YouTube Manager is a strategic and creative leader who translates our clients’ business priorities into long‑form video content, and builds the top real estate channels across the country.

You’re not just managing YouTube channels. You’re leading strategy, storytelling, and systems behind uploads that scale our clients’ local authority to hundreds of thousands of impressions a year on YouTube. You are a multifaceted creative fluent in ideation, production planning, copywriting, post‑production oversight, and YouTube analytics. You’ll work to craft standout content that changes how top agents and teams approach media and market dominance. You will lead production, posting, and packaging direction, distill insights into engaging content, and ensure continuous improvement through analysis and feedback loops. You’ll maintain strategic alignment with key business initiatives and collaborate with YouTube Strategists, Client Success Managers, the creative team, and client teams to shape channel strategy, content production, and distribution.

If the idea of leading and growing YouTube’s top real estate channels excites you, let’s talk.

Responsibilities

  • Team Leadership and YouTube Infrastructure
  • Manage editors, thumbnail designers, and pre‑production team across multiple client accounts
  • Support relevant YouTube scorecard metrics (CTR, retention, view velocity, follower growth) and present insights to leadership and clients
  • Support scalable, documented systems for scripting, packaging, and production handoffs
  • Grow and develop direct reports and members of the YouTube Team
  • Explore and test AI tools to accelerate pre‑ and post‑production workflows; prototype AI‑driven content testing, retention analysis, and scripting support
  • Coordinate with marketing, shorts teams, and external stakeholders for distribution and promotion
  • YouTube Strategy and Channel Architecture
  • Support channel growth strategy with input from clients
  • Balance evergreen local content with timely reactions to market trends and experimental formats
  • Ensure every video educates and reinforces the authors’ authority, credibility, and mission while maintaining each brand’s distinct tone
  • Support the visual identity of packaging and run A/B tests on back catalogue
  • Keep scorecard metrics up to date and share weekly insights with team and clients
  • Pre‑Production
  • Support ideation and research sessions
  • Provide feedback on packaging briefs and video outlines
  • Maintain a four‑to‑six‑week buffer of fully approved topics (outlines, rough thumbnail concepts, title options)
  • Post‑Production
  • Own post‑production timelines and upload calendar
  • Conduct regular retention reviews to improve engagement
  • Collaborate with Senior Editor for retention notes and final approvals
  • Create brand guidelines, SOPs, and artifacts to streamline post‑production
  • Results
  • Support 45‑60+ videos monthly within your team, managing around 5–10 clients
  • 90%+ on‑time delivery rate
  • Client channels achieving 100–1000 subscriber growth monthly
  • Support client revenue goals (generating leads monthly and $7.5–$10M+ in sales per client per year)
  • 50–75% of videos outperform baselines on impressions and subscriber growth
  • Lift in subscriber‑to‑view ratios; higher average views and faster velocity
  • Regular documentation of content experiments and A/B tests
  • Improved use of AI and other tools to increase team leverage
  • Positive client sentiment on brand and growth

Requirements

  • Understanding of the YouTube landscape—concepts, thumbnails, titles, and retention editing
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Analytical fundamentals and ability to work with data
  • 2+ years of relevant experience in YouTube channel development; bonus points for a large educational channel
  • Proficiency with editing notes tools (e.g., Frame.io)
  • Proficiency with project management tools (e.g., Notion)
  • Proficiency with G Suite
  • Knowledge of editing and Photoshop is a plus but not required

Communication Expectations

  • We use Slack as the primary communications tool
  • We value over‑communication and speed in responses
  • Weekly Creative Team Meetings
  • Weekly meetings with Media Manager/Team Leader
  • Weekly meetings with the creative team

Location : Remote (work from home)

Hours : Mon – Fri 9am–6pm EST with flexibility to work weekends when needed

Compensation : $16,800 – $28,800 USD annually with progression from part‑time to full‑time. Highly experienced YouTube strategists can earn $24,000–$36,000 USD per year.

Benefits

  • 30–60 day paid trial period
  • Flexible work arrangements (part‑time to full‑time path)
  • Remote work flexibility
  • Performance‑based advancement opportunities

Knwn Local Core Values

Our core values are the heart of this company. The right person will appreciate and embody them:

Beyond Excellence

We raise the bar and pursue mastery; excellence is a moving target.

Extreme Ownership

Own the outcome and take responsibility for results. Measure yourself by client success.

Proactive Curiosity

Curious minds build better things. Question everything and see challenges as opportunities.

Mission Focused

Align personal purpose with professional pursuit and help others succeed.

To apply

If you’re interested, please submit the following:

  1. A resume in PDF format named as: (Lastname.Firstname.YouTube-Manager.pdf)
  2. Links to YouTube channels you’ve managed and their growth metrics
  3. Link to your completed personality quiz: (link removed)
  4. Your answer to: What’s the most innovative YouTube strategy you’ve implemented and results?
  5. Your answer to: What does this quote mean to you personally? "Work is love made visible"

Submissions should go to:

I encourage applicants to format submissions for ease of review and am happy to answer questions about the role.

At A Impact Media, we don\'t just create videos we transform real estate businesses. If you\'re exceptional at what you do and align with our core values: proactive curiosity, transparent communication, extreme accountability, and beyond excellence, we want to know you.

We\'re hiring a YouTube Editor to join our specialized creative team serving 55+ real estate clients on a full-time, remote basis.

As a YouTube Editor focused on real estate content, you will play a critical role in transforming raw footage into high-impact content. These retention-driven videos generate millions in sales for our clients. You will work directly under our YouTube Manager and alongside a high-performing media team, shaping stories that drive growth and strengthen personal brands. This role combines creative ownership with collaborative problem-solving, turning real estate expertise into world-class content together.

Responsibilities:

As a YouTube Editor focused on real estate content, your role is to transform direct-to-camera, area-touring videos, and agent expertise into high-impact, retention-driven videos that generate leads and build authority. You\'ll solve the problem of turning valuable real estate insights into world-class content that holds attention and drives growth.

  • Edit and deliver multiple high-quality YouTube videos every week, maintaining consistent 72-hour turnaround times

  • Communicate daily, promptly, and often

  • Collaborate with team members to create engaging promotional content from long-form edits

  • Report progress daily and align priorities to maintain seamless workflows

  • Conduct competitor analysis and trend research to stay ahead of industry standards

  • Keep project files and asset management well-organized and up-to-date

  • Share editing resources (e.g., motion graphics templates, intros) with other team members

  • Provide feedback on raw footage to the production team for improved outcomes

  • Monitor client channels for performance metrics and optimization opportunities

  • Eagerness to experiment with new tools, workflows, and approaches to stay ahead

  • Strong alignment with A Impact Media\'s core values and team culture

You\'ll be expected to contribute not just as an editor but also as a creative partner, helping to build a culture of excellence across the media team.

Results:

Your work will directly support our clients\' channel growth and elevate content quality, ensuring they stay ahead of industry standards and audience expectations.

  • Deliver high-quality edits on time, driving strong retention and watch time metrics

  • Support a consistent publishing cadence by maintaining a healthy backlog of ready-to-go content

  • Contribute to growing our clients\' reach and impact, targeting strong view velocity and engagement metrics

  • Maintain creative standards across the team by contributing to internal systems, workflows, and overall visual direction in alignment with client brands

  • Enable real estate professionals to deliver consistent, high-value market insights to their audiences content that would not exist without your contribution

Location:

Fully remote position - work from anywhere with reliable WiFi

Compensation:

Monthly paybased on volume output, skill & experience. 30-60 day paid trial period to ensure mutual fit

Benefits:

  • Flexible remote work environment

  • Work with 55+ established real estate clients generating $10M+ income annually

  • Part of a dedicated team of 55+ creative professionals

  • Structured production system with clear processes and support

  • Growth opportunities into creative management/leadership roles

  • Flexible workload options

A Impact Media Core Values

Our core values determine who succeeds here. The right person will live these values, not just read them.

Beyond Excellence

We raise the bar, then we raise it again. Good enough is not good enough. We find joy in the pursuit of mastery and believe excellence is a moving target.

Extreme Ownership

Own the outcome. Take full responsibility for results. Say "I will" instead of "they should." Measure yourself by your clients\' success.

Proactive Curiosity

Curious minds build better things. Question everything. Connect ideas others miss. Ask "What if?" and "Why not?" See challenges as opportunities to learn.

Mission Focused

Small things build big things. Align personal purpose with professional pursuit. Find fulfillment in the work itself. Believe that helping others succeed is the highest calling.

If you\'re interested, please submit the following:

  • A link to your resume in PDF format with the following naming convention: (Lastname.Firstname.YouTube-Editor-Sao-Paulo.pdf)

Atuar em projetos de consultoria multi-clientes, garantindo a disponibilidade, desempenho e segurança de ambientes em nuvem AWS. Realizar análises para otimização, automação e escalabilidade, contribuindo para melhoria contínua e inovação nas soluções entregues aos clientes.

  • Criar e manter documentação técnica.
  • Colaborar em projetos de modernização e transformação digital.

Competências técnicas

  • Experiência com AWS: EC2, S3, RDS, VPC, CloudWatch, CloudTrail, IAM.
  • Conhecimento em contêineres (Docker/Kubernetes/EKS).
  • Experiência em automação (AWS CLI, PowerShell, CloudFormation; Terraform é diferencial).

  • Redes (TCP/IP, DNS, Load Balancers).

  • Mentalidade de Transformação: Disposição para propor e influenciar com análises, buscando constantemente a melhoria dos processos.
  • Aprendizagem Contínua: Ser um pilar de capacitação para o time e para a empresa, sempre buscando novos conhecimentos.

title: Tech Lead (Sub-Acquirer)
description:
Come Make an Impact on Millions of Brazilians!

At RecargaPay, we’re on a mission to deliver the best payment experience for Brazilian consumers and small businesses — by building a powerful digital ecosystem where the banked and unbanked connect, and where consumers and merchants have a one-stop shop for all their financial needs.

We serve over 10 million users and process more than USD 4 billion annually. We’ve been profitable since 2022 and operate our own credit business. We are an AI-first, 100% remote team, scaling in the rapidly changing Brazilian financial market.

Our goal? Deliver the best payment experience in Brazil for people and small businesses alike.

We value autonomy, ownership, and a bias for action. We’re looking for people who are curious, hands-on, and driven by impact — who want to solve real problems, work with strong teams, and rethink what’s possible.

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.

Responsibilities

As a Tech Lead, you will play a strategic role, serving as a technical reference and team leader. This position requires a balance between technical expertise, people leadership, and project management.

  • Define team objectives and project goals, ensuring alignment with the company's broader strategies and objectives.
  • Facilitate communication within the squad and across technical and non-technical teams, ensuring alignment and timely delivery of high-quality outcomes.
  • Actively participating in the recruitment, training, and development of team members, fostering a productive and growth-oriented environment.
  • Collaborating with other technical leaders, aligning technology strategies and contributing to the evolution of the company's technical direction.
  • Ensuring the technical quality of deliverables, providing guidance and support in solving complex problems.
  • Promote the adoption of AI-assisted engineering practices within your squad and chapter, leveraging tools for code generation, automated refactoring, test case creation, and technical documentation. Identify opportunities where AI can enhance developer productivity, code quality, and team velocity.
  • Guide conversations to remove blockers and encourage collaboration in your team.
  • Collaborate with the Product Owner to ensure technical initiatives, such as refactoring, performance tuning, and tech debt—are properly scoped and prioritized within the product backlog.
  • Ensure implementation of quality and observability standards, including automated testing, monitoring, alerting, and logging across the development lifecycle.
  • Lead retrospectives and continuous improvement efforts, driving team evolution through feedback and actionable insights.
  • Support team staffing decisions by matching people to tasks based on skills, priorities, and development opportunities.
  • Support the definition and follow-up of individual development goals aligned with team objectives and business priorities.
  • Academic background oriented toward computer science, engineering, or software development disciplines.
  • Proven track record of leading teams and working in product-driven companies.
  • Hands-on experience in backend (Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, PostgreSQL, AWS) and optionally frontend development, with a track record of delivering scalable systems.
  • Experience in Python is a plus.
  • Experience with asynchronous programming.
  • Experience working with domains of medium to high complexity.
  • A solid understanding of how web and mobile applications work including security, session management, and best development practices.
  • Knowledge of relational database systems and Object Oriented Programming.
  • Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and experience designing or maintaining microservices-based systems.
  • Ability to work and thrive in a fast-paced environment, learn rapidly and master diverse web and mobile technologies and techniques.
  • Practical experience applying AI frameworks in development projects.
  • Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle and experience with agile methodologies.
  • Advanced Problem-Solving and Decision-Making Skills.
  • Ability to engage both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Competence in defining clear objectives and ensuring the team meets project milestones.
  • Experience guiding and leading teams to successful project deliveries within deadlines and budgets.
  • Ability to evaluate and prioritize technical work based on business value, system health, and long-term platform goals.
  • Experience conducting code reviews, driving knowledge sharing, and promoting collaborative development practices.
  • Experience building and developing high-performing engineering teams.
  • Active contribution to aligning technological strategies with broader organizational objectives.


Soft Skills

  • Ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, facilitating alignment and decision-making.
  • Strong collaboration skills to work effectively with Product Managers, Product Owners, Squad Leaders, Designers, and other teams, tribes or squads in defining priorities and delivering value.
  • Experience mentoring engineers, guiding career development, and fostering a growth-oriented, high-performance team environment.
  • Capacity to make thoughtful, context-aware decisions that balance technical debt, delivery speed, and business impact.
  • Ability to recognize team dynamics, support team members through challenges, and cultivate psychological safety.
  • Proactive in owning outcomes, addressing blockers, and ensuring that the squad delivers on commitments.
  • Comfortable working in changing environments, reprioritizing as needed, and adjusting to new business or technical demands.
  • Skilled in managing disagreements constructively and promoting consensus through dialogue.
  • Capable of influencing product and technical decisions at squad level and beyond, aligning technical initiatives with broader company goals.
  • Oriented toward retrospectives, feedback loops, and implementing process and culture improvements.
  • High degree of autonomy and accountability, with a bias for action and results-oriented problem solving.
  • Comfort operating at both strategic and hands-on levels, flexing between system design and stakeholder engagement as needed.
  • Ability to make decisions based on accurate information, technical indicators, and impact metrics, using data to prioritize initiatives, guide trade-offs, and measure success.


Industry-Specific Knowledge

As a Tech Leader, you bring practical familiarity with one or more core financial domains, such as lending, payments, credit cards, open finance, fraud prevention, merchant acquiring, or investment services, and understand the operational workflows, regulatory considerations, and business impact that shape these areas.

You leverage this knowledge not only to guide the technical implementation of backend solutions, such as payment orchestration, fraud-detection services, or onboarding flows, but also to collaborate with Product Managers, Designers, and business stakeholders in defining priorities and making trade-offs that balance technical feasibility with strategic objectives.

Your role involves translating domain-specific requirements into actionable tasks, mentoring engineers to understand the business context behind their work, and ensuring the team delivers solutions that are robust, compliant, and aligned with customer needs. You help the squad connect technical work with revenue, performance, and user experience outcomes, creating an environment where engineers contribute with full awareness of business impact.

Process Stages

HR Interview
Our first contact will be a casual conversation to learn about you, your career journey, and align expectations. We’ll conduct a brief technical assessment and answer your questions about the role, our culture, and what makes us unique. We want you to get to know us better too! ????
Assessment (skills mapping)
We use an evaluation tool to map your work style and how you align with our culture. This step helps us understand how your skills can enhance our solutions.
Technical Assessment
Now it’s time to showcase your technical talent! In this step, you’ll solve technical cases and have a discussion with our engineering team. We’ll dive into your decisions, strategies, and how you design scalable and robust solutions. Beyond evaluation, we want to exchange ideas and explore how your solutions can impact RecargaPay!

Conversation with Leadership
Here, you’ll meet the squad leader to understand the position’s challenges, discuss the team’s daily activities, and evaluate alignment between our goals, culture, and your career aspirations. This will be an open space to align expectations and ensure RecargaPay is a place where you can grow and make a difference. ????
Offer
If we’ve made it this far together, we’d be thrilled to invite you to join our team! You’ll receive a detailed proposal with all the information about the role, benefits, and the impact you’ll have with us. We can’t wait to welcome you!
Note: There may be an additional step if specific alignments are needed.

  • Competitive and market-aligned salary.
  • Remote work — wherever you are, you’re part of the team!
  • Home office allowance through a monthly deposit in the RecargaPay app.
  • Health and dental plans with no co-pay.
  • Life insurance.
  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay
At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the use of your Data
By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. You can request the update or deletion of your information at any time, in accordance with LGPD (General Data Protection Law).

description:
Join to apply for the Medical Specialist role at Innodata Inc.

Innodata (NASDAQ: INOD) is a leading data engineering company. With more than 2,000 customers and operations in 13 cities around the world, we are an AI technology solutions provider-of-choice for 4 out of 5 of the world's biggest technology companies, as well as leading companies across financial services, insurance, technology, law, and medicine. By combining advanced machine learning and artificial intelligence (ML/AI) technologies, a global workforce of subject matter experts, and a high-security infrastructure, we\'re helping usher in the promise of AI. Job Title: Generative AI Associate Analyst (LLM Training – Medical Domain)

Location: Remote

Employment Type: Flexible Contract Role (Part-time, up to 25 hours weekly)

Overview

We are seeking highly qualified professionals with a Master\u2019s or PhD in Medical Microbiology to support the development of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs). As a Rater / AI Trainer, you will shape how AI understands and communicates complex biomedical knowledge, with a focus on microbiological sciences. This role involves evaluating AI-generated responses for scientific accuracy, contextual integrity, and clinical relevance within medical microbiology. Your feedback and annotations will inform the improvement of AI systems used in healthcare education, diagnostics support, public health communication, and biomedical research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Critically assess AI-generated responses in topics including microbial taxonomy, infectious disease mechanisms, host8pathogen interactions, diagnostic microbiology, antimicrobial resistance, and laboratory methodologies.
  • Apply structured annotation to texts, including labeling for scientific correctness, terminology accuracy, logical structure, and clinical relevance.
  • Categorize model outputs using domain-specific taxonomies (e.g., pathogen type, disease process, diagnostic method).
  • Create real-world clinical or laboratory scenarios with researchers to design and test prompts to assess the model\'s reasoning and adaptability to professional contexts (e.g., interpreting culture reports, recommending diagnostic tests, understanding resistance profiles).

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Medical Microbiology, Immunology, or a closely related biomedical discipline.
  • Demonstrated expertise in core areas such as microbial pathogenesis, clinical diagnostics, virology, bacteriology, parasitology, and immunology.
  • Familiarity with laboratory procedures, microbiological instrumentation, and interpretation of diagnostic test results (e.g., blood cultures, PCR, AST).
  • Excellent written communication skills and fluency in English.
